detail.abstract: Economists from different countries have been actively studying the relationship between the level of fiscal decentralization and economic growth since the mid-70s. However, back in the 50s, English economists Martin and Lewis noted that "... The weakness of local authorities in relations with central ones is one of the most noticeable phenomena for developing countries..." [3, p.111]. A study by other scholars John Mixes and Mark Sandberg on the level of fiscal decentralization in developed and developing countries, conducted in the mid-80s, revealed a trend that fully confirms the conclusions of Martin and Lewis.

AI.tldr: 该论文回顾了财政分权与经济增长关系的研究历史，从20世纪50年代Martin和Lewis的观察到80年代Mixes和Sandberg的研究，都表明发展中国家地方政府相对于中央政府的弱势地位是一个显著现象。
AI.research_question: 财政分权水平与经济增长之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 自20世纪70年代中期以来，各国经济学家一直在积极研究财政分权与经济增长的关系，但早在50年代就有学者注意到发展中国家地方政府相对于中央政府的弱势现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政分权理论、经济发展理论、中央与地方关系理论
AI.method: 文献回顾和历史分析，梳理了从20世纪50年代到80年代的相关研究
AI.findings: Martin和Lewis在50年代指出的发展中国家地方政府相对于中央政府的弱势现象，在80年代Mixes和Sandberg的研究中得到了完全证实
AI.theory_contributions: 为财政分权与经济增长关系的研究提供了历史脉络，验证了早期学者关于发展中国家地方政府弱势现象的观察
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家制定财政分权政策提供了历史经验和理论支持

title: The Relationship Between the public Debt and Economic Growth: The Case of Upper-Middle-Income European Countries

detail.title: The Relationship Between the public Debt and Economic Growth: The Case of Upper-Middle-Income European Countries
detail.abstract: Most results from numerous studies show that the public debt rate has a negative effect on economic growth (Misztal, 2021; Panizza & Presbitero, 2014; Afonso & Alves, 2015; Reinhart & Rogoff, 2010a). Therefore, the aim of this paper is to empirically analyze the relationship between the public debt and economic growth for 16 upper-middle-income European countries for the period from 2000 to 2020. Our sample consists of three subgroups: the countries of the Western Balkans, upper-middle-income countries states members of the European Union (EU), and other developing European countries. The study employs panel regression models such as ordinary least squares (OLS), fixed-effects, and random-effects models, in order to test the relationship of the public debt-to-gross domestic product (GDP). Almost all models indicate that the relationship between debt-to-GDP is weakly negatively correlated with economic growth, where a 1% increase in debt-to-GDP decreases economic growth by 0.034%, even the average debt-to-GDP of our sample is 35.02%. Moreover, the findings of this study contribute to the literature regarding the public debt ratio and economic growth in developing countries.

AI.tldr: 本文实证分析了2000-2020年间16个欧洲中高收入国家公共债务与经济增长的关系，发现债务占GDP比率与经济增长呈弱负相关，债务比率每增加1%，经济增长减少0.034%。
AI.research_question: 欧洲中高收入国家的公共债务与经济增长之间是否存在负相关关系？
AI.motivation: 多数研究表明公共债务率对经济增长有负面影响，本文旨在对16个欧洲中高收入国家进行实证分析验证这一关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Misztal(2021)、Panizza & Presbitero(2014)、Afonso & Alves(2015)、Reinhart & Rogoff(2010a)等关于公共债务与经济增长关系的理论框架
AI.method: 面板回归模型，包括普通最小二乘法(OLS)、固定效应模型和随机效应模型
AI.findings: 几乎所有模型都表明债务占GDP比率与经济增长呈弱负相关，债务比率每增加1%，经济增长减少0.034%，样本平均债务比率为35.02%
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家公共债务比率与经济增长关系的文献做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲中高收入国家制定公共债务政策提供实证依据

title: Welfarism without Independence
affiliations: University of Oxford

detail.title: Welfarism without Independence
detail.abstract: The official economic notion of welfarism requires the respect of the Independence of Irrelevant Alternatives (IIA) condition. Intuitively, however, welfarism is not bound by the binariness encoded by IIA. Welfarism fundamentally means welfare consequentialism, and IIA is added baggage. The technical notion of welfarism is, in this respect, artificially constrained. Motivated by that simple but apparently underappreciated observation, this conceptual note makes first steps towards a more adequate notion of welfarism. Its main contribution is to introduce a particularly inclusive generalization of IIA. That generalization targets and unifies a large class of cases where IIA is violated inasmuch as the evaluation method builds on specially selected welfare functions at the individual level. The proposed new condition is used to obtain an improved characterization of welfarism—which includes traditional welfarism as a special case—and, as a proof of concept, an improved characterization of utilitarianism which includes Classical Utilitarianism, Relative Utilitarianism, and the Borda Count, among others, as special cases. These results are further interpreted in light of various recent discussions of non-welfarism.

AI.tldr: 本文对福利主义的经济学定义提出批判，认为传统的无关选项独立性(IIA)条件人为限制了福利主义的概念。作者提出了一个更包容的IIA泛化条件，并基于此改进了对福利主义和功利主义的特征化描述。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个更恰当的福利主义概念，使其不受无关选项独立性(IIA)条件的不必要限制？
AI.motivation: 传统福利主义定义被IIA条件人为约束，而直觉上福利主义本质是福利后果主义，IIA是额外负担。这一简单但被低估的观察促使作者重新思考福利主义概念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利主义理论、无关选项独立性(IIA)、福利后果主义、功利主义理论框架
AI.method: 概念性分析，提出新的IIA泛化条件，并通过该条件重新特征化福利主义和功利主义
AI.findings: 提出的新IIA泛化条件能够统一处理大量违反传统IIA的情况，特别是在评价方法基于个体层面特别选择的福利函数时。基于此获得了改进的福利主义和功利主义特征化描述。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了更包容的IIA泛化条件；2) 改进了福利主义的特征化描述；3) 改进了功利主义的特征化描述，将古典功利主义、相对功利主义、博尔达计数法等统一纳入
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解各种非福利主义讨论提供了新的理论框架，有助于更准确地评估不同社会福利评价方法

detail.abstract: This study undertakes a comprehensive examination of the underlying rationale behind the imposition of tariffs by the United States, particularly under the Trump administration, on any developing countries. The primary objective is to assess the advantages and disadvantages of these measures for both the U.S. economy and the global economic environment. To achieve this, the research introduces an innovative model for tariff evaluation that adopts a more practical and realistic perspective, enabling a clearer and more systematic analysis of the strategic intentions driving such policies. Furthermore, the study incorporates newly developed concepts, definitions, and Scheme to enhance the objectivity and depth of the analysis. However, the newly developed Tariff Effects Interconnectivity Scheme (TEI-Scheme) introduces innovative concepts and a straightforward methodological framework, both of which are detailed in the same research. At the same time, the TEI-Scheme is using artificial intelligence (AI). Finally, the TEI-Scheme was applied to examine the effects of U.S. tariffs on developing countries theoretically.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了关税效应互联方案（TEI-Scheme），采用人工智能方法分析特朗普政府时期美国对发展中国家征收关税的战略意图和经济影响，评估这些措施对美国和全球经济环境的利弊。

detail.abstract: Spousal cofounding teams are common, yet we know little about how they affect startups' ability to attract new hires. While prior work highlights internal advantages of spousal teams, such as trust, cohesion, and resilience, we propose that they may trigger concerns among external audiences by blurring professional and personal roles. Focusing on prospective employees, we predict that startups led by spousal cofounders face an "illegitimacy discount" in hiring, attracting fewer applicants, especially when the lead founder is male. We test these claims using a preregistered field experiment embedded in a live early-stage recruitment process. We find that candidates are less likely to apply to a startup cofounded by spouses and that this penalty is asymmetric: it is pronounced when the lead founder is male but weaker when the lead founder is female. Analysis of the Panel Study of Entrepreneurial Dynamics II (PSED II) corroborates external validity: spousal cofounding teams are prevalent but hire less than comparable nonspousal teams. Together, the results extend research on founding team composition and gender disparities in entrepreneurship by showing how spousal cofounding affects talent attraction and how gendered expectations condition perceptions of legitimacy in early startup hiring.

AI.tldr: 夫妻共同创办的初创公司在招聘时面临"合法性折扣"，申请人较少，特别是当主导创始人为男性时这种惩罚更明显。
AI.research_question: 夫妻共同创办团队如何影响初创公司吸引新员工的能力？
AI.motivation: 夫妻创业团队很常见，但我们对它们如何影响外部人才吸引知之甚少。虽然先前研究强调了夫妻团队的内部优势，但它们可能引发外部受众对专业和个人角色混淆的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合法性理论、性别期望理论、创业团队构成理论
AI.method: 预注册现场实验（嵌入实际早期招聘过程）和PSED II面板数据分析

AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了创业团队构成和创业中性别差异的研究，展示了夫妻共同创办如何影响人才吸引，以及性别期望如何调节早期创业招聘中的合法性认知

title: Comparing Free Market and Communist Economic Principles

detail.title: Comparing Free Market and Communist Economic Principles
detail.abstract: Capitalism, a system based on private ownership of the means of production, introduces the question: Is the free market a boon or a bane? This essay examines how the hope of profit drives strategic investment behaviors and profit maximization, as well as its potential to provoke immorality and income inequality. Regardless of its economic insufficiencies, such behavior outweighs the benefits of comprehensive government control of enterprises. The latter disincentivizes innovation and hinders efficiency, leading to cycles of unmanageable inflation and debt.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了资本主义制度下自由市场的利弊，认为尽管追求利润可能引发不道德行为和收入不平等，但相比政府全面控制企业，自由市场仍具有优势，因为政府控制会抑制创新、降低效率，导致通货膨胀和债务问题。
AI.research_question: 自由市场是福是祸？资本主义制度下的利润驱动机制对社会经济的影响如何？
AI.motivation: 资本主义基于生产资料私有制，引发了关于自由市场利弊的讨论，需要分析利润驱动对投资行为、道德和收入分配的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本主义理论、自由市场经济理论、政府干预理论
AI.method: 理论分析和比较分析
AI.findings: 利润驱动虽然可能引发不道德行为和收入不平等，但相比政府全面控制企业，自由市场更能促进创新和效率，避免通货膨胀和债务危机。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对资本主义制度下利润驱动机制的理解，比较了自由市场与政府控制的相对优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于市场调节与政府干预平衡的参考，强调了保持市场活力的重要性。

keywords: Gravity Absorption Inverse Process in Black Holes (GAIP-BH)
The Regenerative and Recycling Function of Black Holes

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a new theoretical framework in modern physics: The Quantum Surface Model in a Simulated Singularity Field. It proposes that black holes are not mere gravitational sinks but dynamic multidimensional recycling systems that sustain the continuous regeneration and expansion of the universe. The model integrates three innovative ideas: (1) Gravity Absorption Inverse Process in Black Holes (GAIP-BH), (2) The Regenerative and Recycling Function of Black Holes, and (3) Galactic Recycling and Expansion through Black Hole Hyperactivity. These concepts redefine black holes as multidimensional kinetic reactors that absorb gravitational energy, invert its directionality, and recycle it into new matter, space-time curvature, and quantum field structures. The framework is developed through Ruiz Estrada's Dynamic Coordinate System (REDCS), which visualizes and mathematically represents multidimensional interactions between gravitational curvature, quantum fields, and energy transformations. The paper concludes that the universe operates as a self-regenerating and selfrecycling continuum, maintained by the hyperactivity of interconnected black holes that expand and renew the cosmic fabric perpetually.

affiliations: National Research University – Higher School of Economics (HSE University)

detail.title: Policy Pathways for Progress: Study of Economic, Environmental, and Governance Determinants of HDI in Pakistan

publicationDetails.detailsText: BRICS Journal of Economics, volume 6, issue 2, 2025[10.3897/brics-econ.6.e146935]

detail.abstract: This study examines the key economic, environmental and governance determinants of the Human Development Index (HDI) in Pakistan, using a multidimensional framework to analyze their long-and short-term dynamics. Using annual data from 1990 to 2022 the research applies Johansen Cointegration Test and Vector Error Correction Model (VECM) to assess the relationships between HDI and factors that may exert influence on its dynamics, including exports, remittances, military expenditure, carbon dioxide emissions, debt service, population growth, and women's parliamentary representation. Its findings reveal that governance and demographic factors, particularly women's representation in parliament and population growth, have significant positive impacts on the country's HDI in the long run, highlighting the importance of inclusive governance and resource management. Conversely, economic variables such as exports and remittances appear to have negative long-term effects on the HDI, suggesting structural inefficiencies in Pakistan's trade and remittance policies. Environmental degradation, represented by carbon dioxide emissions, poses a significant challenge with adverse effects on the HDI, in both the short and long term. Military expenditure demonstrates dual effect: while it supports the HDI in the long run by fostering stability, in the short run it diverts resources away from critical social investments. The study emphasizes the need for policy reforms to diversify exports, formalize remittance channels, and adopt sustainabilityfocused environmental strategies. To promote equitable development, it is essential to increase women's representation in governance and balance the defense and social spending. This research contributes new insights by integrating economic, environmental, and governance dimensions into unified analytical framework tailored to Pakistan’s socioeconomic context and provides actionable recommendations for policymakers to prioritize sustainable and inclusive development initiatives in line with the global Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

AI.tldr: 本研究使用1990-2022年数据，通过Johansen协整检验和VECM模型分析巴基斯坦HDI的经济、环境和治理决定因素。研究发现女性议会代表和人口增长对HDI有正向影响，而出口、汇款和碳排放有负向影响，军费支出具有双重效应。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦人类发展指数（HDI）的关键经济、环境和治理决定因素是什么？这些因素在长期和短期内如何影响HDI？
AI.motivation: 需要理解巴基斯坦HDI的多维决定因素，为促进可持续和包容性发展提供政策建议，符合全球可持续发展目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多维发展框架，整合经济、环境和治理维度；协整理论和向量误差修正模型。
AI.method: 使用1990-2022年的年度数据，应用Johansen协整检验和向量误差修正模型（VECM）分析变量间关系。
AI.findings: 治理和人口因素（女性议会代表、人口增长）对HDI有显著正向影响；经济变量（出口、汇款）有负向长期效应；碳排放对HDI产生不利影响；军费支出具有双重效应（长期稳定vs短期资源挤占）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济、环境和治理维度整合到统一分析框架中，为巴基斯坦社会经济背景量身定制；提供了对发展决定因素的新见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供可操作建议：出口多样化、汇款渠道正规化、环境可持续战略、增加女性治理代表、平衡国防与社会支出，以促进公平发展。

title: Entrepreneurial Exposure with Intergenerational Mobility
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Entrepreneurial Exposure with Intergenerational Mobility
detail.abstract: Do locally rooted expansions in entrepreneurship change children's chances of upward mobility? This paper assembles a tract-level U.S. dataset harmonized to 2010 geographies and links self-employment around 2000 to Opportunity Atlas earnings ranks for cohorts 1978-1983. To isolate causality, I implement a Bartik-style instrument that interacts 1990 self-employment shares with 1990-2000 house-price-driven credit growth, estimating 2SLS models with rich tract controls, state fixed effects, countyclustered inference, and weak-IV-robust Anderson-Rubin tests. The estimates trace a clear distributional gradient: large, precisely estimated gains in adult rank for children from the bottom of the distribution (roughly p1-p25), attenuating toward the median, near zero by p75, and small negatives at p100; patterns are similar for boys and girls and in White-only panels. First stages are very strong, placebo reassignments of the shifter fail as expected, and results persist when adding explicit county/CZ spillover controls and when using a state-only shifter; Conley-style bounds that allow limited direct effects leave the core bottom-tail conclusions intact. Substantively, credit-enabled small-business growth appears to expand local job ladders, networks, and role-model exposure in ways that disproportionately raise upward mobility for children starting from low-rank backgrounds, with modest effects around the middle and little to slightly negative effects at the very top.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，基于本地根基的企业扩张通过信贷推动的小企业增长，显著提高了来自收入分布底端儿童的向上流动机会，但对中高收入背景儿童影响较小甚至为负。
AI.research_question: 本地根基的企业扩张是否会改变儿童的向上流动机会？

AI.findings: 发现明显的分布梯度：来自收入分布底端（约p1-p25）的儿童获得显著的向上流动收益，向中位数衰减，到p75接近零，在p100处为小幅负值；男女孩和纯白人样本模式相似。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业扩张对向上流动影响的异质性分布特征，深化了对小企业作为社会流动机制的理解。

title: Integrating the FLRW Equation into Financial Valuation: A Novel Methodology for TV Estimation in a DCF Framework

detail.title: Integrating the FLRW Equation into Financial Valuation: A Novel Methodology for TV Estimation in a DCF Framework
detail.abstract:
This thesis seeks to explore the relationship between company’s present value (PV) and the respective market price of its security, by implementing a modified DCF model. In this framework, the terminal value is recalculated using a multivariable approach inspired by the Friedmann–Lemaître–Robertson–Walker (FLRW) equation, a theoretical solution to Einstein’s field equations, that describes the expansion of the universe over time, potentially toward infinity. By drawing parallels between cosmological expansion and the long-term growth trajectory of the firms, expressed by the growth rate (g), this study aims to integrate a more dynamic, scientifically grounded methodology into financial valuation.

This approach aspires to elevate the robustness of DCF models prediction power, offering a new lens through which to estimate long-term value in a theoretically rigorous manner. Findings highlight a preference for macro-oriented models, with Models 2 and 3 producing the strongest and most relevant results. Model 2 demonstrates exceptional reliability by anchoring valuation to macroeconomic drivers such as inflation, while the FLRW-inspired Model 3 not only achieves empirical robustness but also opens new possibilities for flexible, ad-hoc modeling. In contrast, Model 1 proved weak and inconsistent, underscoring the need for more adaptive approaches.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过修改DCF模型，使用受FLRW宇宙膨胀方程启发的多变量方法重新计算终值，探索公司现值与证券市场价格的关系。研究发现宏观导向模型表现更佳，特别是锚定通胀的模型2和FLRW启发的模型3。
AI.research_question: 公司现值与其证券市场价格之间的关系是什么？如何通过改进的DCF模型更准确地估计长期价值？
AI.motivation: 传统DCF模型在估计长期价值时存在局限性，需要更动态、科学基础的方法来提升估值模型的预测能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 修改的DCF模型，结合FLRW宇宙膨胀方程理论，将宇宙膨胀与企业长期增长轨迹进行类比。
AI.method: 实施修改的DCF模型，其中终值使用受FLRW方程启发的多变量方法重新计算。
AI.findings: 宏观导向模型表现最佳：模型2（锚定通胀）可靠性高，模型3（FLRW启发）兼具实证稳健性和建模灵活性，模型1表现弱且不一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 将宇宙学理论引入金融估值，为DCF模型提供了新的理论框架，增强了长期价值估计的科学基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了更稳健的估值方法，特别是模型2和模型3为投资决策提供了更可靠的估值工具，模型3还支持灵活的定制化建模。

detail.abstract: Amidst initial advancements in decentralization such as the constitutionalization of local autonomy in 1973 and the landmark enactment of RA 7160, also known as the Local Government Code (LGC), several Local Government Units (LGU) continue to grapple with persistent institutional challenges that hinder the full realization of the country's decentralization objectives. It is within this context that the Center for Local and Regional Governance (CLRG) initiated the UGNAYAN Webinar Series which aims to gather insights and facilitate discussions on necessary policy reforms to address decentralization issues. The first webinar took place on June 30, 2023, and broadly explored the futures of local governance in the Philippines. This policy brief outlines some of the major policy reform areas discussed during the webinar.

detail.title: The Size and Composition of Global Commercial Real Estate Markets

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 25-84

detail.abstract: The article analyzes the evolution from 2001 to 2024 of the size and composition of commercial real estate investment markets. The evolution of the composition of the market through time is done both by region and by sector. We first focus on global figures, and then discuss some trends for Europe. Design/Methodology/Approach We analyze the size of commercial real estate investment markets over time. The current size of the market is compared with the market capitalization of stocks and bonds. We then focus on changes in the composition of the real estate investment market by geographical region and sector. We also provide analyses for Europe and to a lesser extent the Asia-Pacific and North American regions. Findings Having trebled in size from 2001 to 2024, the value of global real estate markets is USD 12,428 billion as of the end of 2024, with the U.S. market accounting for 39% of that figure. The importance of office and retail sectors has diminished over time, while that of residential and industrial investments has increased. The size of the European investment market is USD 3,873 billion, with the U.K., German, and French markets accounting for 57% of that amount. Wide discrepancies in sectoral compositions are observed across European markets. The markets of China, Japan, Hong Kong and Australia dominate the Asia-Pacific region, while U.S. markets constitute the bulk of markets in North America. Originality/Value This paper provides for a better understanding of the size and composition of commercial real estate investment markets. This is important for investors wishing to invest in the asset class. Among other things, we compare the size of the real estate market with that of stock and bond markets. We also provide insights concerning possible changes in the future.

title: The "Demons" in Demonstration: Unintended Consequences of Superstar-oriented R&D Subsidy Policy in China

detail.title: The "Demons" in Demonstration: Unintended Consequences of Superstar-oriented R&D Subsidy Policy in China
detail.abstract: This paper examines the unintended consequences of selective R&D subsidy policies that target leading firms, focusing on the innovation activities of non-subsidized competitors and new entrants. Although such subsidies are typically intended to stimulate innovation, the paper utilizes a Schumpeterian model to demonstrate that they may, in fact, discourage innovation among competitor firms and deter the entry of new firms, thereby undermining aggregate innovation. Empirical evidence from the "National Technological Innovation Demonstration Firm (NTIDF)" policy in China substantiates these theoretical predictions, showing a 21.7% increase in R&D expenditure by subsidized firms, contrasted with a 30% reduction in R&D investment among competitor firms lagging behind the productivity frontier and a 7.6% decline in private firm entry. Taken together, these divergent effects lead to an average 8.3% decrease in quality-weighted patent outputs at the industry-city pairs where certified demonstration firms are located. The paper highlights the necessity of accounting for competitive dynamics in the design of innovation policies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，针对领先企业的选择性研发补贴政策可能产生意外后果：虽然受补贴企业研发支出增加21.7%，但非补贴竞争对手的研发投资减少30%，新企业进入减少7.6%，最终导致行业专利产出下降8.3%。
AI.research_question: 选择性研发补贴政策对非补贴竞争对手和新企业进入的创新活动会产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然研发补贴政策旨在刺激创新，但可能对竞争格局产生意外影响，需要评估其对整体创新生态的净效应。

AI.method: 理论模型与实证分析相结合，使用中国'国家技术创新示范企业'政策数据进行验证

AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了选择性补贴政策的意外后果，强调了考虑竞争动态在创新政策设计中的重要性

title: Time Constraints and the Quality of Physician Care
affiliations: CUNEF Universidad

detail.title: Time Constraints and the Quality of Physician Care
detail.abstract: This paper studies how easing time constraints improves workers’ performance and output quality. I build a unique, high-frequency administrative dataset containing timeuse data on all physicians in an outpatient department. I leverage a natural experiment by which physicians, when randomly affected by a cancellation, spend unexpected extra time with their next patient. I find that longer visits lead to improved care, evidenced by more detailed diagnoses, increased testing intensity, and lower drug prescriptions. I also find long-term health effects, measured by fewer hospital readmissions. These findings highlight that relaxing workers’ time constraints significantly enhance their productivity and output quality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自然实验研究发现，放宽时间限制能显著提高医生的工作表现和医疗质量。当医生因预约取消获得额外时间时，会提供更详细的诊断、增加检查强度、减少药物处方，并降低患者再入院率。
AI.research_question: 放宽时间限制如何影响工作者的表现和产出质量？
AI.motivation: 探索时间约束对专业人员工作质量的影响，特别是在医疗领域这种时间压力较大的环境中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间约束理论、工作绩效理论、医疗服务质量理论
AI.method: 利用自然实验方法，分析医生因预约取消获得意外额外时间后的行为变化，使用高频行政数据构建独特数据集。
AI.findings: 更长的就诊时间带来更好的医疗服务：更详细的诊断、更高的检查强度、更低的药物处方率，以及长期健康效益（更低的再入院率）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为时间约束与工作绩效关系提供实证证据，扩展了时间管理理论在专业服务领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗机构优化排班和时间管理提供依据，表明适当放宽时间限制能提高医疗质量和患者健康结果。

title: Federal Budget Analysis and Recommendations: Pakistan (FY 2025–26)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Federal Budget Analysis and Recommendations: Pakistan (FY 2025–26)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no personal or financial relationship with any organization or individual. The purpose of this research is for my profile building and to show my skills.

detail.abstract: This dissertation offers a comprehensive analysis of Pakistan’s federal budget for fiscal year 2025-26, evaluating the fiscal strategy supported by IMF-mandated reforms. With a total outlay of PKR 17.573 trillion, the budget shows a deliberate 7% decrease from FY 2024–25 levels, aligning with macroeconomic stability goals. Key targets include cutting the fiscal deficit to 3.9% of GDP (from 5.9%), achieving a primary surplus of 2.4%, and boosting GDP growth to 4.2%. Revenue measures aim to strengthen tax collection through digital enforcement and AI audits, raising the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) tax target to PKR 14.131 trillion, along with PKR 5.147 trillion in non-tax revenues. Defense spending increases by 20% to PKR 2.55 trillion (~2.5% of GDP), surpassing development allocations such as the PKR 1 trillion PSDP. Interest payments (PKR 8.207 trillion) and pensions (PKR 1.055 trillion) dominate current expenditure. The dissertation uses ratio analysis (deficit/GDP, debt servicing share), sectoral allocation comparisons, and benchmark comparisons with IFC standards and peers. Results show limited fiscal space for productivity-led priorities, especially education and health. Recommendations focus on broadening the tax base—particularly in agriculture and informal sectors—refinancing high-cost debt, redirecting resources toward human development, and strengthening implementation through the Uraan Pakistan strategy (five-year plan). The study concludes that while FY 2025–26 demonstrates disciplined fiscal consolidation, its success relies on proper execution and ongoing structural reforms.

AI.tldr: 该论文对巴基斯坦2025-26财年联邦预算进行全面分析，评估IMF改革支持的财政战略。预算总额17.573万亿卢比，比上一财年减少7%，旨在实现宏观经济稳定。主要目标包括将财政赤字降至GDP的3.9%，实现2.4%的基本盈余，GDP增长4.2%。研究发现财政空间有限，建议扩大税基、债务再融资、资源重新分配至人力发展。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦2025-26财年联邦预算的财政战略是否有效实现宏观经济稳定目标？
AI.motivation: 评估IMF改革支持的财政战略，分析巴基斯坦在财政整顿与经济增长之间的平衡，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政政策理论、宏观经济稳定理论、财政空间理论、结构性改革理论
AI.method: 比率分析（赤字/GDP、偿债占比）、部门分配比较、与国际金融公司标准和同行的基准比较
AI.findings: 预算显示财政赤字目标从5.9%降至3.9%，基本盈余2.4%，GDP增长4.2%；国防支出增长20%至2.55万亿卢比，超过发展支出；利息支付和养老金占经常性支出主导；财政空间有限，尤其教育和卫生领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对发展中国家在IMF改革背景下财政整顿与增长平衡的理论理解，丰富了财政空间和结构性改革的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦政府提供扩大税基（特别是农业和非正规部门）、高成本债务再融资、资源重新分配至人力发展、加强Uraan巴基斯坦战略实施的具体政策建议。

title: A Very Testable VINES Theory of Everything: A 5D Framework for Unifying Fundamental Physics
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: A Very Testable VINES Theory of Everything: A 5D Framework for Unifying Fundamental Physics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/q
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/q
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: As an Retired researcher driven by the quest to unify physics, I present the VINES Theory of Everything (ToE), a 5D warped Anti-de Sitter (AdS) framework derived from Type IIA String Theory on a Calabi-Yau threefold with string coupling g_s = 0.12. VINES unifies gravity, quantum mechanics, the Standard Model (SM), supersymmetry (SUSY) with soft breaking at 1 TeV, dark matter (DM) as a 100 GeV scalar and sterile neutrinos, and dark energy (DE) with w_DE ≈-1. It resolves cosmological tensions via early dark energy (EDE), explains baryon asymmetry through leptogenesis, and incorporates non-perturbative quantum gravity via a matrix theory term. Starting from a 10D Einstein-Yang-Mills-fermion action, VINES employs gauge-Higgs unification for the Higgs, an index-theorem constraint for three chiral SM families, fermion localization for flavor hierarchies, and vacuum energy sequestering with an axion-like field to address the strong CP problem. Constrained by Planck 2018, ATLAS/CMS 2023, XENONnT, and DESI data, VINES uses 19 parameters (5 free, 14 fixed) to predict CMB non-Gaussianity (f_NL = 1.28 ± 0.12), Kaluza-Klein (KK) gravitons at 1.6 TeV, DM relic density (Ω_DM h^2 = 0.119 ± 0.003), black hole (BH) shadow ellipticity (5.4% ± 0.3%), gravitational waves (Ω_GW ≈ 1.12 × 10^-14 at 100 Hz), Hubble constant (H_0 = 71.5 ± 0.7 km/s/Mpc), neutrino CP phase (δ_CP = 1.5 ± 0.2 rad), baryon asymmetry (η_B = 6.1 ± 0.2 × 10^-10), proton decay (τ_p→e^+π^0 ≳ 10^35 yr), and axion couplings (g_aγγ). These are testable by CMB-S4, LHC, XENONnT, ngEHT, LISA, DESI, DUNE, Hyper-Kamiokande, and ADMX by 2035. Computational validations using CLASS, microOMEGAs, and GRChombo, with codes at https://github.com/MrTerry428/MADSCIENTISTUNION, confirm results. The string landscape is reduced to 3 vacua via flux stabilization. A 2025-2035 experimental roadmap positions VINES as a leading ToE candidate.

AI.tldr: VINES理论是一个从IIA型弦理论导出的5维弯曲反德西特框架，统一了引力、量子力学、标准模型、超对称性、暗物质和暗能量，解决了宇宙学张力，并通过实验数据验证了多项可观测预测。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的物理理论框架，能够同时解释引力、量子力学、标准模型、暗物质、暗能量等基本物理现象？
AI.motivation: 追求物理学统一，解决当前理论物理中的基本问题，如引力与量子力学的统一、暗物质和暗能量的本质、宇宙学参数张力等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于IIA型弦理论在卡拉比-丘流形上的构造，采用5维弯曲反德西特空间框架，包含规范-希格斯统一、费米子局域化、真空能量隔离等理论机制。
AI.method: 从10维爱因斯坦-杨-米尔斯-费米子作用量出发，运用弦理论构造、通量稳定化、计算物理验证（CLASS、microOMEGAs、GRChombo）等方法。
AI.findings: 理论预测了CMB非高斯性、KK引力子、暗物质遗迹密度、黑洞阴影椭圆率、引力波、哈勃常数、中微子CP相、重子不对称性、质子衰变寿命等可观测物理量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个完整的万物理论框架，统一了基本相互作用，解决了多个长期存在的理论问题，如强CP问题、宇宙学张力等。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的实验验证路线图（2025-2035），预测了多个可通过现有和未来实验验证的物理现象，为实验物理提供了明确的研究方向。

title: Implementación de instrumentos de la política de vivienda sobre el mercado de alquiler de vivienda residencial en España. (Implementation of housing policy instruments in the residential rental housing market in Spain.)
affiliations: , Universidad de Alicante and Universidad de Alicante

detail.title: Implementación de instrumentos de la política de vivienda sobre el mercado de alquiler de vivienda residencial en España. (Implementation of housing policy instruments in the residential rental housing market in Spain.)
detail.abstract:
Spanish Abstract: Tras la crisis financiera global (CFG), la política de vivienda en España experimentó un cambio de orientación, desplazando recursos públicos de los programas para la adquisición de viviendas en propiedad hacia programas para el arrendamiento de viviendas residenciales para mejorar la accesibilidad a la vivienda, especialmente entre colectivos vulnerables. Este estudio analiza la efectividad de los instrumentos programáticos, financieros y fiscales implementados a través de estos programas desde 2013, sobre el control de precios y el aumento del stock de viviendas protegidas y sociales en alquiler. Mediante un enfoque cuantitativo, se examinan los presupuestos públicos, los programas de los Planes Estatales de Vivienda (PEV), el uso de fondos europeos (Fondos Next Generation EU) y los beneficios fiscales, contrastando el esfuerzo financiero estatal antes y después de la introducción de dichos fondos. Los resultados evidencian una aplicación ineficiente de las políticas, la ausencia de evaluación de impacto, y efectos no deseados como la traslación de ayudas a precios, una escasa respuesta de la oferta y un uso fiscalmente recaudatorio de los instrumentos. El artículo concluye que las políticas actuales no han logrado alcanzar sus objetivos de control de precios ni de mejora en el acceso al alquiler, subrayando la necesidad de una revisión profunda de los mecanismos empleados, mayor coordinación interadministrativa y una evaluación rigurosa de la efectividad de las medidas adoptadas.

English Abstract: Following the global financial crisis (GFC), housing policy in Spain underwent a shift in focus, redirecting public resources from programs for homeownership towards programs for rental housing, with the aim of improving housing affordability, particularly for vulnerable groups. This study analyzes the effectiveness of the programmatic, financial, and tax instruments implemented through these programs since 2013, focusing on their impact on controlling rental prices and increasing the supply of affordable and social rental housing. Using a quantitative approach, it examines public budgets, the programs within the National Housing Plans (PEV), the use of European funds (Next Generation EU Funds), and tax benefits, comparing the level of public funding before and after the introduction of these funds. The results reveal inefficient policy implementation, a lack of impact evaluation, and unintended consequences such as the pass-through of subsidies to higher rents, limited supply response, and the use of these instruments as a revenue-raising measure. The article concludes that current policies have failed to achieve their objectives of controlling rental prices and improving access to affordable housing, underscoring the need for a thorough review of the mechanisms employed, greater inter-agency coordination, and rigorous evaluation of the effectiveness of the measures adopted.

AI.tldr: 西班牙住房政策在金融危机后从支持购房转向租赁住房，但2013年以来的政策工具在控制租金和增加保障性租赁住房供应方面效果不佳，存在政策执行低效、缺乏评估、补贴转化为更高租金等问题。
AI.research_question: 西班牙2013年以来实施的住房政策工具（包括计划性、财政和税收工具）在控制租金价格和增加保障性租赁住房存量方面的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 全球金融危机后，西班牙住房政策重点从购房转向租赁，旨在提高住房可负担性，特别是对弱势群体。需要评估这些政策工具的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房政策有效性评估框架，包括政策工具分析、公共资源配置效率、政策执行评估等理论。
AI.method: 定量研究方法，分析公共预算、国家住房计划项目、欧盟下一代基金使用情况、税收优惠，对比这些基金引入前后的国家财政投入。
AI.findings: 政策执行效率低下，缺乏影响评估，产生意外后果：补贴转化为更高租金、供应反应有限、工具被用作创收手段。
AI.theory_contributions: 为住房政策有效性评估提供了实证证据，揭示了政策工具设计不当可能导致的反效果，丰富了住房政策执行理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出当前政策未能实现控制租金和改善租赁住房获取的目标，强调需要彻底审查机制、加强跨部门协调和严格评估措施有效性。

title: PrEP Impact Tool for Modeling PrEP Expansion in Latin America and the Caribbean
affiliations: World Health Organization (WHO) - Global HIV, Hepatitis and STI Programme, Pan American Health Organization, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Pan American Health Organization and World Health Organization - Regional Office for the Americas

detail.title: PrEP Impact Tool for Modeling PrEP Expansion in Latin America and the Caribbean

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors are staff members and consultants of the Pan American Health Organization. The authors alone are responsible for the views expressed in this publication, and they do not necessarily represent the decisions or policies of the Pan American Health Organization

detail.abstract: Background: PrEP use in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) has increased, with 280,000 people receiving it by 2024. Yet new HIV infections remain stable, concentrated among key populations-men who have sex with men (MSM) and transgender women (TG). Methods: The PrEP Impact (PI) tool was developed to help LAC countries estimate the public health impact of expanding oral PrEP and introducing long-acting lenacapavir (LEN) from 2025-2035. Effectiveness was set at 86% for oral PrEP and 99% for LEN, using UNAIDS Spectrum and national data. Four scenarios were compared: (1) Status Quo-3% annual increase; (2) Expanded Use-10% annual growth in 2025-2026, then 5% thereafter; (3) Greatly Expanded Use-10% annual growth from 2026 onward; and (4) LEN Introduction-same as scenario 3, with 60% using LEN and 40% oral PrEP (adjusted oral PrEP effectiveness 94%). No change in HIV care cascade coverage was assumed. Results: Compared with 2022, Scenario 1 projects a 16% reduction in new infections by 2035. Scenario 2 yields a 63% reduction by 2035, requiring 1.8 million people on PrEP. Scenario 3, reaching that level by 2031, achieves a 73% decline earlier. Scenario 4, combining oral PrEP and LEN, yields an 83% reduction by 2031 with the same number of users. Conclusions: Ambitious national PrEP targets are essential to substantially reduce new HIV infections. PI offers a programmatic tool to inform these goals. Integrating LEN with oral PrEP could accelerate epidemic decline, emphasizing the urgency of expanding prevention options in LAC.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了PrEP Impact工具，用于评估拉丁美洲和加勒比地区扩大口服PrEP和引入长效lenacapavir对HIV新发感染的公共卫生影响。研究发现，通过扩大PrEP覆盖率和引入新药，到2035年可减少63-83%的新感染。
AI.research_question: 在拉丁美洲和加勒比地区，扩大口服PrEP覆盖率和引入长效lenacapavir对HIV新发感染有何公共卫生影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管LAC地区PrEP使用人数增加至28万，但HIV新发感染仍稳定在高位，主要集中在男男性行为者和跨性别女性群体中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于UNAIDS Spectrum模型和各国数据，评估不同PrEP推广策略的效果。
AI.method: 开发PrEP Impact工具，比较四种情景：现状维持、扩大使用、大幅扩大使用、以及引入长效lenacapavir。设定口服PrEP有效性86%，LEN有效性99%。
AI.findings: 情景1到2035年减少16%新感染；情景2减少63%；情景3提前到2031年减少73%；情景4结合口服PrEP和LEN，到2031年减少83%。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了程序化工具PI，为制定国家PrEP目标提供依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明扩大PrEP覆盖率和引入新药可显著加速HIV疫情下降，强调了在LAC地区扩大预防选择的紧迫性。

title: Eliminating Avoidable Blindness in Rural India: A DALY-Based Economic Burden and Cost–Benefit Analysis
affiliations: Drashti Netralaya and

detail.title: Eliminating Avoidable Blindness in Rural India: A DALY-Based Economic Burden and Cost–Benefit Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicting relationship exists for any author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This was a secondary analysis of aggregated, publicly available data (national surveys, GBD estimates, economic statistics). No individual-level data were collected or analyzed; no human participants were recruited or contacted; and no identifiable information was used. In accordance with prevailing standards, the work is exempt from Institutional Review Board (IRB) review.
declarations.funderStatement: No financial support received from any company or institution.

detail.abstract:
Background: Most vision loss in rural India is avoidable, yet economic evidence comparing the annual burden with the one-time cost of scaling eye-care services remains scarce.

Methods: We conducted a model-based economic evaluation from a societal perspective. Outcomes were disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) monetized using GDP-per-capita valuation and a one-time program cost to eliminate avoidable blindness (cataract surgery, refractive services, outreach, vision centres, human resources, monitoring and evaluation, information–education–communication, logistics, and overhead). Results are reported per one million rural population and scaled to ~900 million rural residents. Two scenarios were examined: a conservative DALY rate (~6,020 DALYs/million; GBD-anchored) and a macro upper-bound (100,000 DALYs/million via 5% visually impaired × 2 DALYs/person). Sensitivity analyses varied DALY valuation (0.5–1.5× GDPpc) and unit costs.

Findings: Annual economic burden per million was US$16.2 million (conservative) to US$250 million (macro). One-time program cost per million was US$0.99–1.60 million (benchmark US$1.25 million), yielding benefit–cost ratios of ~10–16:1 (conservative) and ~200:1 (macro). Scaled to rural India, the conservative burden is ~US$14.6 billion/year versus a one-time ~US$0.89–1.44 billion. Payback is well under two months in both scenarios.

Interpretation: Eliminating avoidable blindness in rural India is an exceptionally high-return investment. Mission-mode expansion of cataract and refractive services—prioritizing high-burden, low-coverage districts and tracking effective coverage—can rapidly convert recurring welfare losses into durable health and economic gains.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过模型化经济评估发现，在印度农村消除可避免性失明是一项极高回报的投资。保守估计下效益成本比为10-16:1，宏观估计下可达200:1，投资回收期不到两个月。
AI.research_question: 在印度农村消除可避免性失明的经济可行性如何？其效益成本比和投资回收期是多少？
AI.motivation: 印度农村大多数视力损失是可避免的，但缺乏将年度负担与一次性扩大眼保健服务成本的比较经济证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会视角的模型化经济评估，使用伤残调整生命年(DALYs)货币化方法。
AI.method: 从社会视角进行模型化经济评估，将DALYs按人均GDP估值，并与消除可避免性失明的一次性项目成本比较。分析了保守和宏观两种情景。
AI.findings: 每百万农村人口年度经济负担为1620万至2.5亿美元，一次性项目成本为99-160万美元。效益成本比保守估计为10-16:1，宏观估计为200:1。投资回收期不到两个月。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了在发展中国家农村地区进行眼保健投资的经济评估框架，证明了高回报的健康投资可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政府扩大白内障和屈光服务的任务模式扩张提供经济依据，建议优先覆盖高负担、低覆盖地区并追踪有效覆盖率。

title: Higher Education and Finance: An Economic Analysis of Colleges as Business Entities
affiliations: Fordham Preparatory School Finance Club, Fordham Preparatory School Finance Club and Fordham Preparatory School Finance Club

detail.title: Higher Education and Finance: An Economic Analysis of Colleges as Business Entities
detail.abstract: Three members of the Fordham Prep Finance Club-Alexangel Ventura, Thomas Spellman, and Luis Torres-aim to tackle the question of whether or not college should be deemed "a business" by contextualizing historical trends in the university system and making parallels to the modern student experience. They gather data both sourced from the internet as well as conducting their own unique survey to make an accurate assessment of the business qualities of the American college system. They found that while rising costs are contributing to greater fear among students and the public correlation between colleges and businesses, and they are distributing less of their funds toward academics, they offer substantial financial assistance to those who need it.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨大学是否应被视为"企业"，通过分析大学系统的历史趋势和现代学生体验，发现虽然成本上升导致学生和公众将大学与企业联系起来，且大学将更少资金用于学术，但它们为有需要的学生提供了大量经济援助。
AI.research_question: 大学是否应被视为"企业"？
AI.motivation: 通过分析大学系统的历史趋势和现代学生体验，探讨大学是否具有企业特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将大学系统与企业进行比较分析的理论框架。
AI.method: 收集互联网数据并进行独特的问卷调查，评估美国大学系统的企业特性。
AI.findings: 成本上升导致学生和公众将大学与企业联系起来，大学将更少资金用于学术，但为有需要的学生提供了大量经济援助。

AI.practical_contributions: 帮助学生和公众更准确地理解大学的运作模式和经济特性。

title: Regulatory Reset: A Policy Roadmap for Expanding Financial Advice to Middle- and Lower-Income Canadians
affiliations: C.D. Howe Institute

detail.title: Regulatory Reset: A Policy Roadmap for Expanding Financial Advice to Middle- and Lower-Income Canadians
detail.abstract:
• Reduced access to financial advice is closely linked to lower participation in tax-advantaged savings and investment programs. This is largely due to limited financial literacy and behavioural inertia – barriers that financial advisors are uniquely positioned to help Canadians overcome.
  • Limited financial participation at the individual household level has broader economic consequences: lower household financial resilience, reduced national savings, and diminished capital formation constrain economic growth and productivity in Canada.
  • This paper analyzes the link between cumulative and uncoordinated regulation and a widened “advice gap” in Canada. It highlights the macroeconomic risks of reduced access to financial guidance across income groups.
  • The paper recommends a framework that maintains strong consumer protections but also fosters accessibility, scalability, and innovation. Such reforms are essential to expanding participation, enhancing competition, and driving national prosperity.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了加拿大金融监管与金融建议缺口扩大的关系，指出缺乏金融建议导致税收优惠储蓄投资参与度降低，进而影响宏观经济。论文建议在保持消费者保护的同时，通过改革促进金融建议的可及性和创新。
AI.research_question: 累积且不协调的监管如何导致加拿大金融建议缺口的扩大，以及这种缺口对宏观经济产生什么风险？
AI.motivation: 金融建议获取减少与税收优惠储蓄投资参与度降低密切相关，这主要源于有限的金融素养和行为惯性，而金融顾问能够帮助加拿大人克服这些障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融素养理论、行为经济学（行为惯性）、金融监管理论、宏观经济影响理论
AI.method: 政策分析和宏观经济影响评估
AI.findings: 金融建议缺口扩大导致家庭财务韧性降低、国民储蓄减少、资本形成受限，从而制约加拿大的经济增长和生产力。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了金融监管、建议缺口与宏观经济表现之间的理论联系框架，深化了对金融建议在促进金融参与中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一个在保持强有力消费者保护的同时，促进金融建议可及性、可扩展性和创新的政策框架，有助于扩大金融参与、增强竞争和推动国家繁荣。

detail.abstract: This document provides a brief analysis of whether a university degree can truly guarantee a bright future in the labor market. The main contribution of this short academic note is to evaluate the past, present, and future of education, while also addressing how the rise of Artificial Intelligence (AI) presents a new dilemma. This dilemma revolves around comparing formal higher education (university) with practical, self-directed learning (through the internet). It challenges us to rethink and redesign the traditional education system, making it more practical and adaptable to the needs of new generations in an evolving labor market. Additionally, this document provides a brief analysis of whether a university degree can truly guarantee a bright future in the labour market. The main contribution of this short academic note is to evaluate the past, present, and future of education, while also addressing how the rise of Artificial Intelligence (AI) presents a new dilemma. This dilemma revolves around comparing formal higher education (university) with practical, self-directed learning (through the internet). It challenges us to rethink and redesign the traditional education system, making it more practical and adaptable to the needs of new generations in an evolving labour market. These changes are expected to drive a profound reorganization of both the economy and society over the future. To address these challenges, we propose a basic economic theoretical framework that can provide a clearer understanding of the future of our increasingly complex and dynamic economic world.

title: Quantifying Inequality in Blockchain Networks
affiliations: University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB), Yale University, , University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) and Cornell University - Samuel Curtis Johnson Graduate School of Management

detail.title: Quantifying Inequality in Blockchain Networks
detail.abstract: Inequality measures such as the Gini coefficient are widely used to motivate public policy [6], and are being increasingly applied in blockchain settings to design fairer mechanisms. [1, 9, 16]. Several challenges impair the reliability of inequality measures. First, the pseudonymous nature and the fact that actors may create multiple sybil accounts, distort asset distribution. Second, there are complex token-holding patterns, where an entity's assets may be stored across various smart contracts. In this work we propose methods to improve the accuracy of inequality measurements in blockchain networks. We empirically test these methods on Ethereum and assess policy impacts. Our results suggest that while inequality in Ethereum appeared to decline over time, and several previous protocol changes such as the transition from PoW to PoS indeed reduced inequality, this trend has recently reversed.

detail.abstract: This study examines the interplay between green energy, green finance, and digitalization in fostering environmental sustainability across a panel of emerging economies from 2000 to 2024. Utilizing advanced panel econometric techniques, including Cross-Sectional Augmented IPS (CIPS) and CADF unit root tests, Pedroni and Westerlund cointegration methods, and a CS-ARDL model, the analysis reveals that renewable energy adoption, green financial mechanisms, and digital transformation significantly mitigate CO₂ emissions in both the short and long term. Conversely, GDP per capita demonstrates a positive correlation with emissions, underscoring the ecological trade-offs of economic growth. Trade openness exhibits a modest negative link with CO₂ emissions, implying that its environmental effects may vary based on trade structure and policy frameworks. Robustness checks via FMOLS and DOLS estimators validate the reliability of these results, while the Dumitrescu-Hurlin Granger causality test confirms unidirectional causality from renewable energy, green finance, and digitalization to emissions reduction. The findings emphasize the critical need for holistic policy strategies that simultaneously scale up renewable energy infrastructure, strengthen green financing instruments, and promote digital innovation to drive sustainable decarbonization. Additionally, sector-specific regulations, public-private partnerships, and international cooperation are vital to maximizing synergies among these drivers. By offering empirical evidence across multiple emerging economies, this study enriches the discourse on low-carbon transitions and provides actionable insights for policymakers seeking to balance economic development with ecological preservation. The research also highlights the importance of technology transfer and capacity-building in ensuring equitable green growth, particularly for developing nations. Ultimately, this work contributes to a deeper understanding of the pathways toward achieving global climate targets while fostering inclusive and sustainable development.

title: From Rhetoric to Reform: Civil Service Employment Structures and the Measurement of Government Efficiency
affiliations: Independent Researcher and Independent Researcher

detail.title: From Rhetoric to Reform: Civil Service Employment Structures and the Measurement of Government Efficiency
detail.abstract: Improving government efficiency has long been a central policy objective. Reducing inefficiency enables governments to expand services without increasing expenditures, lower the costs of current service levels, or achieve both simultaneously. While the goal is broadly shared, the effectiveness of specific policy interventions varies. This study applies production efficiency metrics-technical, allocative, and scale efficiency-to evaluate whether employment structure (at-will vs. merit-based) correlates with government performance. Drawing on state-level data across core functions including transportation, infrastructure, public safety, welfare, and health, we find no meaningful differences in efficiency between employment systems. We argue that policymakers should shift focus toward empirically grounded interventions targeting input composition, labor quality, and organizational design. Measures to promote good management practices in the government and civil servant competence are more likely to improve government efficiency. Tools grounded in the economic theory of production offer tractable methods for diagnosing inefficiency and guiding reform.

title: Beyond the Benefits: Early Childcare Expansion and Maternal Health in Germany
affiliations: University of Augsburg and University of Augsburg

detail.title: Beyond the Benefits: Early Childcare Expansion and Maternal Health in Germany
detail.abstract: This paper studies the effects of early childcare availability on maternal health by exploiting variation following a major reform in Germany. Linking county-level childcare coverage rates with individual data from the German Socio-Economic Panel, we find that a 10-percentage-point increase in childcare availability reduces mothers’ self-assessed health by 0.173 points (19% of a SD). Further analyses show negative effects on maternal physical and mental health, and satisfaction with health. Investigating channels, we find evidence consistent with infection transmission and employment-related stress, including declines in work and leisure satisfaction. Notably, partners’ health remains unaffected, leading to a widening health gap within households.

title: The Experience Semantic Protocol: Engineering the Genome of Human Experience - A Technical Specification and Vision for Direct Experience Transfer

detail.title: The Experience Semantic Protocol: Engineering the Genome of Human Experience - A Technical Specification and Vision for Direct Experience Transfer
detail.abstract: Human language transmits approximately 50 bits per second while the brain processes 10⁶-10⁷bits¹—a compression catastrophe of 10⁴-10⁵×. We propose the Experience Semantic Protocol (ESP),a wire protocol for transmitting human experience as typed, orthogonal latent vectors. Like DNAencodes life using four bases, ESP encodes experience using five fundamental types: Knowledge(KNO), Intention (INT), Emotion (EMO), Context (CTX), and Sensory (SEN), plus temporal encoding(TEM) for continuity. Through Typed Orthogonal Semantic Spaces (TOSS), we achieve a privacybound I(EMO; KNO) ≤ 0.01 under regularization λ = 5 (see Theorem 2) while enabling selectivesharing and progressive fidelity. We present the complete specification, from L1 implementationsfeasible today (512 dimensions, 50Hz) to future L∞ brain-computer interfaces. This paper provideswire formats, state machines, mathematical proofs, and implementation guidance for what weargue will become the fundamental protocol for experience transfer in the coming decades.

AI.tldr: 提出了Experience Semantic Protocol (ESP)，一种用于传输人类经验的线协议，使用五种基本类型（知识、意图、情感、上下文、感官）和时序编码，通过类型化正交语义空间实现隐私保护和选择性共享。

detail.abstract: No preamble is needed to elucidate the catastrophic upshots the world is undergoing in the aftermath of the military intervention of Russia in Ukraine. Since the war commenced on Feb. 24, between the two former Soviet states, Russia has been consistently intimidating Ukraine about using nukes in the war. This current has been ignited after the Russian military, in March this year, seized Zaporizhzhia nuclear power Plant, the largest power station in Europe and the 10th largest nuclear power plant in the world. The labyrinth that ensued, as a result, is that the seizure is frightening not just to Ukraine but rather to the whole of Europe and the world. Amid experiencing the grim economic and political upshots due to the war, the leaders of the international institutions such as the UN and IAEA and different states are gravely concerned with the unpredictable military trajectory of Russia regarding Zaporizhzhia. Since the power station was seized in March, the Russian military has been accused of continuous shelling in and outside of the nuclear power station. Causing ferocious damage, a series of shelling and blasts hit the station that further resulted in disconnecting a reactor from Ukraine’s electricity grid. Therefore, it has given rise to a pressing tension among the scholars of security studies who are scared of a radiological disaster in case of worsening situations and continuous shelling around the station by Russia.

title: Meta-Learning in Biologically-Informed Recurrent Neural Networks for Personalized System Identification of Glucose-Insulin Dynamics
affiliations: , University of Bergamo, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Università degli Studi di Bergamo, , University of Bergamo - Department of Management, Information and Production Engineering and University of Bergamo - Department of Management, Information and Production Engineering

detail.title: Meta-Learning in Biologically-Informed Recurrent Neural Networks for Personalized System Identification of Glucose-Insulin Dynamics
detail.abstract: The management of Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus remains a major challenge, as it requires continuous regulation of blood glucose levels. Automated systems, such as the artificial pancreas, address this need by relying on accurate patient-specific models. While linear physiological models are popular in the literature due to their interpretability, their linear structure struggles to capture the complex dynamics of the glucose-insulin system, resulting in low prediction performance. This is particularly challenging given the significant inter-patient variability in glucose-insulin dynamics. More complex models, such as Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), can achieve high modeling performance, but their black-box structure lacks interpretability, reducing clinical trust and leading to possible problems for regulatory acceptance. In this work, we propose a hybrid approach using knowledge-guided learning to structure RNNs to model the glucose-insulin dynamics in diabetic patients, merging biological interpretability with high predictive performance. Furthermore, we present a meta-learning approach to address the problem of inter-patient variability. Statistical analysis will show that the proposed methodologies improve prediction performance while maintaining a high level of interpretability.

title: Existential Threats and Evolving Jus ad Bellum: The June 2025 Israel-Iran Conflict as a Stress Test for International Law's Capacity to Address Persistent State-Sponsored Hostility and WMD Proliferation
affiliations: University of Tehran - Faculty of Law and Political Sciences

detail.title: Existential Threats and Evolving Jus ad Bellum: The June 2025 Israel-Iran Conflict as a Stress Test for International Law's Capacity to Address Persistent State-Sponsored Hostility and WMD Proliferation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This article is intended for academic and policy audiences. The author advocates no particular national position but rather seeks to clarify the legal issues, map competing arguments fairly, and propose principled frameworks for addressing gaps in current doctrine. All views are those of the author and do not represent any government, institution, or organization.

detail.abstract: The twelve-day Israel-Iran armed conflict in June 2025, precipitated by Israel's Operation Rising Lion against Iranian nuclear facilities, represents one of the most legally contested interstate uses of force since the 2003 Iraq invasion. This article provides systematic analysis of competing legal claims under the UN Charter's jus ad bellum framework, examining Israel's assertion of anticipatory self-defense against an imminent nuclear threat alongside the counter-argument that the strikes constituted unlawful preventive war. Drawing on contemporaneous IAEA documentation, UN Security Council records, state notifications, and ICJ jurisprudence, this study analyzes five critical dimensions: the "armed attack" threshold and attribution of proxy warfare under the Nicaragua effective control standard; the contested doctrine of imminence in anticipatory self-defense, particularly regarding WMD contexts; necessity and proportionality constraints given institutional alternatives actively engaged on 12-13 June; the nuclear facility taboo established in UNSC Resolution 487; and procedural deficits, notably Israel's failure to invoke Article 51 explicitly. The analysis concludes that on the public record, the weight of legal reasoning points decisively toward Israeli violation of Article 2(4). Three findings are dispositive: Iran's status at Tier 1-2 on the imminence evidence ladder (advanced capability with verification deficits) fails the Caroline standard, particularly given IAEA Director General Grossi's explicit statement that the Agency found "no proof of a systematic effort to move into a nuclear weapon"; necessity fails because the IAEA Board resolution and Security Council emergency session on 12-13 June demonstrate institutional mechanisms were functioning at the moment Israel struck; and Israel's omission of Article 51 invocation in its 17 June notification—contrary to standard practice for states confident in their legal basis—suggests internal recognition of evidentiary insufficiency. A narrow pathway to lawfulness exists contingent on classified intelligence demonstrating verified weaponization (Tier 3-4 evidence) and operational preparation for imminent attack, but such evidence has not been disclosed and does not appear in official notifications. More fundamentally, the case exposes structural tensions between the Charter's temporal constraints on self-defense and contemporary security dilemmas involving WMD proliferation by hostile states where Security Council enforcement is blocked by permanent member veto. To address this legal-strategic mismatch while preserving the prohibition on preventive war, the article proposes a three-tier framework: orthodox Charter doctrine as the default rule for 95% of cases; a tightly cabined WMD-Specific Imminence Framework requiring five cumulative evidentiary elements (verified weaponization, pattern of armed attacks and threats, irreversible acquisition threshold, institutional exhaustion, strict proportionality) plus mandatory procedural safeguards (immediate Article 51 notification, intelligence disclosure to Security Council, post-hoc verification, ex post review) for exceptional last-resort scenarios; and institutional strengthening (enhanced IAEA authority, Security Council reform, regional nuclear-weapon-free zones) to make unilateral force unnecessary. Applied to June 2025, this framework demonstrates Israeli strikes failed three of five evidentiary elements and all procedural safeguards, confirming unlawfulness even under evolved standards. The study concludes that preventing future conflicts requires addressing systemic deficits—regional insecurity, institutional paralysis, asymmetric norm application—through diplomatic engagement, verified disarmament, mutual security guarantees, and Security Council reforms enabling collective security to function as the Charter envisioned.

detail.abstract: The International Review of Law & Economics is publishing these notes in memory and celebration of Robert D. Cooter--its Editor from 1988 to 2004--offering brief reflections on him as teacher, scholar, and exemplar. A giant of law and economics, Robert D. Cooter combined breadth with creative insight: he helped build a systematic economic understanding of torts, contracts, and property, a novel approach to public law and Constitutional design, and opened new frontiers on the interaction between law and social norms and on the expressive power of law. His humanity and scholarly ethos-curiosity, humor, and intellectual honesty--left a lasting mark on all who had the privilege to learn from him as students, colleagues, co-authors, and friends.

title: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Participation and Cognitive Decline Among Older Americans
affiliations: , Columbia University - Mailman School of Public Health, New York University (NYU) - New York University, University of Georgia, University of Georgia, , University of Georgia - Department of Health Policy and Management, Yale School of Public Health - Department of Health Policy and Management,  and University of Georgia

detail.title: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Participation and Cognitive Decline Among Older Americans

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines how SNAP participation may affect age-related cognitive decline among cognitively intact older adults over 10 years. Leveraging a longitudinal survey of SNAP-eligible participants in the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) collected biennially from 2010 to 2020, we estimate the relationship between SNAP participation and cognitive decline across different population groups. We show that SNAP participation is associated with a slower cognitive decline in global cognition, memory, and executive function. A significant three?way interaction among SNAP participation, race/ethnicity, and time indicates faster decline in global cognition among Non-Hispanic Black and Hispanic SNAP users. Our findings suggest that SNAP participation may help slow age-related cognitive decline. However, the benefits of SNAP vary across different population groups. Policies promoting equitable access to SNAP benefits have significant potential to improve cognitive health across diverse populations.

AI.tldr: SNAP参与可能减缓老年人认知衰退，但效果因种族/族裔而异。非西班牙裔黑人和西班牙裔SNAP使用者的整体认知衰退更快。
AI.research_question: SNAP参与如何影响不同人群的年龄相关认知衰退？
AI.motivation: 研究SNAP福利对老年人认知健康的影响，特别关注不同种族/族裔群体的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于营养援助项目(SNAP)与认知健康关系的理论框架，考虑社会经济因素和健康不平等。
AI.method: 利用健康与退休研究(HRS)2010-2020年纵向调查数据，分析SNAP资格参与者的认知变化。
AI.findings: SNAP参与与较慢的全局认知、记忆和执行功能衰退相关；但非西班牙裔黑人和西班牙裔SNAP使用者整体认知衰退更快。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了SNAP对认知健康影响的异质性，为理解社会福利项目与健康不平等关系提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议制定促进SNAP公平获取的政策，以改善不同人群的认知健康。

title: Spatial Network Design for Public Services
affiliations: University of Waterloo, Northwestern University - Kellogg School of Management and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Spatial Network Design for Public Services
detail.abstract: We aim to design a public service network that spans a spatial area to maximize social welfare, taking into account customers' sensitivity to travel distance and wait times. First, we demonstrate that the problem of spatial service design and pricing with strategic customers who choose a service location that maximizes their expected utility is equivalent to a bilevel design problem, where customers can be directly assigned to service locations. The latter ensures the existence of a service fee mechanism that satisfies the optimal assignment. We show that the spatial area can be divided into a set of disjoint regions, such that within each region, all customers seek service from the same location. We then derive the relationship between the optimal demand rate served at each service location and the optimal capacity (service rate) of the location. Our findings indicate that the optimal service capacity at each location depends on the capacity cost. For example, the square root rule is optimal for linear capacity costs, but this does not hold for nonlinear cost functions. Furthermore, we characterize the relationship between the optimal service fee and capacity, and observe that when the service capacity is fixed and cannot be adjusted, the optimal service fee is higher at locations with higher optimal demand rates. However, when capacity can be optimally allocated, the optimal service fee depends on the cost of capacity. Specifically, if the capacity cost function is linear, optimal capacity allocation leads to optimal social welfare, resulting in all locations charging the same service fee. However, if the capacity cost function is nonlinear, the optimal fee increases with the optimal demand rate when the service cost is strictly convex and decreases when the cost is strictly concave.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了公共服务网络的空间设计与定价问题，旨在最大化社会福利。研究发现服务区域可划分为不相交区域，每个区域内顾客选择同一服务点。最优服务容量取决于容量成本函数形式，线性成本时平方根法则最优，非线性时则不同。当容量固定时，高需求地区收取更高服务费；当容量可优化分配时，线性成本下所有地点收取相同费用，非线性成本下费用随需求率变化。
AI.research_question: 如何在考虑顾客对旅行距离和等待时间敏感性的情况下，设计公共服务网络的空间布局和定价策略以最大化社会福利？
AI.motivation: 公共服务网络设计需要平衡服务可达性、等待时间和运营成本，现有研究缺乏对战略顾客行为和空间因素的整合分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双层优化理论、战略顾客效用最大化理论、空间服务网络设计理论
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，将空间服务设计与定价问题转化为双层设计问题，推导最优需求率与服务容量的关系
AI.findings: 1) 空间区域可划分为不相交区域，每个区域内顾客选择同一服务点；2) 最优服务容量取决于容量成本函数形式；3) 容量固定时高需求地区收取更高费用；4) 容量可优化时，线性成本下统一收费，非线性成本下费用随需求率变化
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了空间服务网络设计的理论框架，揭示了容量成本函数形式对最优定价策略的关键影响，扩展了公共服务网络优化理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共服务机构提供空间布局和定价决策指导，帮助在有限资源下实现社会福利最大化

title: Proposal for the Uruguayan Tax Reform 2025–2029
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Proposal for the Uruguayan Tax Reform 2025–2029
detail.abstract:
The National Budget Bill 2025–2029 of the Oriental Republic of Uruguay marks a turning point in the country’s tax system. The provisions included are not limited to technical adjustments in legislative drafting; rather, they configure a substantial redesign with direct implications for local taxpayers and, in particular, for multinational groups and individuals who have structured their tax planning around the advantages historically offered by this jurisdiction.

One of the first legislative proposals focuses on the establishment of the Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax (DMTT), aligned with OECD’s Pillar 2, which constitutes the centerpiece of the reform. With this measure, Uruguay joins the international trend of guaranteeing a minimum level of taxation of 15% for multinational groups meeting specific revenue thresholds. As seen, this entails reviewing the scope of traditional promotional regimes, such as free trade zones, the software industry promotion regime (Decree 150-007), or the Investment Promotion Law, which have been cornerstones of its policy to attract foreign capital.

Additionally, the reform proposes to deepen the country’s “shift toward a worldwide income system” through the expansion of taxation on foreign-source income for tax residents and the creation of a new “tax holiday” regime for those acquiring residence as of 2026. This generates a novel scenario in which the international mobility of high-net-worth individuals will need to reconsider the structuring of income, assets, and investment locations. This redesign pursues the dual purpose of strengthening domestic revenue collection while maintaining the country’s competitiveness in attracting new tax residents, following the trend initiated in recent years, whereby Uruguay has steadily moved toward adapting its tax system to a worldwide income approach.

Equally relevant are the adjustments to the regime of international postal shipments and the introduction of new rules on payment facilities, statute of limitations on tax debts, access to financial information, and the offsetting of tax credits, which modernize the relationship between taxpayers and the Uruguayan tax administration. Although operational in nature, these changes affect legal certainty and predictability in transactions, both of which are central factors in any cross-border tax planning strategy.

In sum, the projected package of measures reflects the Uruguayan State’s willingness to position itself as a fiscally cooperative jurisdiction, aligned with international standards of transparency and fairness, without renouncing its longstanding vocation to attract capital and investment. For taxpayers and tax advisors, this scenario requires a careful review of current structures and anticipation of the impacts these undeniably significant reforms will have on the design and execution of tax strategies in the region

AI.tldr: 乌拉圭2025-2029年国家预算法案对其税收制度进行了重大改革，包括引入符合OECD支柱2的国内最低补足税、扩大对境外收入的征税范围、调整传统优惠制度，旨在增强财政收入同时保持吸引外资的竞争力。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于OECD支柱2的全球最低税理论、全球所得征税制度理论、税收竞争理论以及税收筹划理论。

AI.findings: 改革将确保跨国企业缴纳15%的最低税，调整传统优惠制度，扩大对居民境外收入的征税，同时引入新的税收假期制度以吸引高净值个人。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家如何在遵循国际税收标准的同时维持税收竞争力提供了实证案例，丰富了全球税收协调与国内税收政策设计之间的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国企业和高净值个人提供了税收筹划的新框架，帮助税务顾问和纳税人预见改革影响并调整现有结构，同时为其他类似经济体提供了改革参考。

title: On the Informational Effectiveness of the Compensation Discussion and Analysis (CD&A): Evidence from Textual Features
affiliations: Independent, University of Connecticut - Department of Finance and University of Connecticut - Department of Finance

detail.title: On the Informational Effectiveness of the Compensation Discussion and Analysis (CD&A): Evidence from Textual Features

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Accounting, Auditing, and Finance (JAAF), Accepted

detail.abstract: Since the SEC's 2006 mandate of the Compensation Discussion and Analysis (CD&A), its disclosure has significantly increased. Shareholders complain that CD&As are difficult to read and lack useful information. Despite uniform SEC guidelines, firms vary significantly in how they construct and organize CD&As. Motivated by these concerns, we investigate the relation between CD&A textual features and their effectiveness in fulfilling the SEC's objective: providing material information to assist shareholders in evaluating executive pay. Using over 12,000+ CD&As from large U.S. firms, we construct textual variables that capture the information processing costs of CD&As, including length, reader-friendliness, and linguistic readability. We find that information asymmetry increases and shareholder support for executive pay decreases after firms file harderto-process CD&As, primarily due to length and lack of reader friendliness. Supporting an agencybased explanation, these CD&As are associated with higher total and excess CEO pay and weaker firm performance. By decomposing CD&A textual processing costs into compliance and residual components, we show that residual components drive undesired disclosure outcomes. Our findings highlight the importance of understanding the textual processing costs of disclosures and how these costs relate to disclosure effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国公司薪酬讨论与分析(CD&A)披露的文本特征与其有效性之间的关系。研究发现，难以处理的CD&A（主要由于长度和缺乏读者友好性）会导致信息不对称增加、股东对高管薪酬支持度降低，并与更高的CEO薪酬和更弱的公司业绩相关。
AI.research_question: CD&A文本特征与其在实现SEC目标（为股东提供评估高管薪酬所需的重要信息）方面的有效性有何关系？
AI.motivation: 尽管SEC有统一指导方针，但各公司在构建和组织CD&A方面存在显著差异，股东抱怨CD&A难以阅读且缺乏有用信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论，关注信息披露处理成本与披露有效性之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用超过12,000份美国大型公司的CD&A，构建文本变量来捕捉信息处理成本，包括长度、读者友好性和语言可读性。
AI.findings: 难以处理的CD&A会导致信息不对称增加、股东对高管薪酬支持度降低，这些CD&A与更高的总CEO薪酬和超额CEO薪酬以及更弱的公司业绩相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过将CD&A文本处理成本分解为合规和残差成分，证明残差成分驱动了不良披露结果，强调了理解披露文本处理成本的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和公司提供了关于如何改进CD&A披露以更好地服务股东利益的实践指导，强调了读者友好性在披露有效性中的关键作用。

title: The Buffer–redundancy Rule: A Cross-domain Law of Stability and Entropy Delay

detail.title: The Buffer–redundancy Rule: A Cross-domain Law of Stability and Entropy Delay

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. The research was conducted independently without any financial or organizational influence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study involves no human participants, personal data, or experiments requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Stability across complex systems seldom results from sheer strength but from the capacity to absorb, delay, and correct shocks. This paper formalizes that universal mechanism as the Buffer-Redundancy Rule (BRR)-a quantitative law describing how redundancy, buffering, and feedback jointly suppress instability and entropy growth. Derived from axioms spanning physical, biological, and institutional domains, the BRR expresses stability as a dynamic balance between transmission and absorption. Three empirical predictions are tested through multidomain models: (P₁) peak reduction and delay, (P₂) cascade suppression, and (P₃) extended response window. The results demonstrate that redundancy provides substitutability, buffering flattens shocks, and feedback extends correction time. The framework generalizes resilience theory by shifting focus from recovery to prevention, and it offers an engineering basis for crossdomain policy and design principles. The BRR further serves as the operational subset of the Triadic Law (Boundary-Buffer-Feedback)-a higher-order architecture of sustainable order.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了缓冲-冗余规则(BRR)，这是一个描述冗余、缓冲和反馈如何共同抑制不稳定性和熵增长的定量定律。该规则表明稳定性是传输与吸收之间的动态平衡，并通过多领域模型验证了三个实证预测。
AI.research_question: 复杂系统中的稳定性如何通过冗余、缓冲和反馈机制实现？
AI.motivation: 复杂系统的稳定性通常不是来自纯粹的力量，而是来自吸收、延迟和纠正冲击的能力。需要形式化这一普遍机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 缓冲-冗余规则(BRR)、三元定律(边界-缓冲-反馈)、弹性理论
AI.method: 基于跨物理、生物和制度领域的公理推导，并通过多领域模型测试三个实证预测
AI.findings: 冗余提供可替代性，缓冲使冲击变平缓，反馈延长纠正时间；验证了峰值减少和延迟、级联抑制和扩展响应窗口三个预测
AI.theory_contributions: 通过将重点从恢复转向预防来推广弹性理论，为跨领域政策和设计原则提供工程基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨领域政策和设计原则提供工程基础，作为可持续秩序高阶架构三元定律的操作子集

detail.title: How Do High Interest Rates Affect Banks

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines empirically how the effect of interest rates on the three components of bank profits – loan loss provisions, net interest margin, and non-interest income – varies depending on bank characteristics and the macroprudential policy environment. A new finding is that higher interest rates lead to larger loan loss provisions for banks offering flexible-rate loans, but that this effect is attenuated when macroprudential borrower-based measures have been tight in preceding years. Tighter macroprudential settings also reduce the effect of higher unemployment on loan loss provisions recorded by banks, and thereby the negative impact of unemployment on profitability. Moreover, we find significant heterogeneity across banks: banks with strong risk appetite that extend loans at flexible rates are adversely affected by higher interest rates, as the effect on loan losses dominates the effect on the interest margin, while the profitability of other banks benefits on average from higher interest rates.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究利率变化对银行利润三个组成部分（贷款损失准备金、净息差、非利息收入）的影响如何因银行特征和宏观审慎政策环境而异。研究发现：高利率导致提供浮动利率贷款的银行增加贷款损失准备金，但该效应在前期实施严格的宏观审慎借款人措施时会减弱；严格的宏观审慎政策也降低了高失业率对贷款损失准备金的影响；不同银行存在显著异质性：具有强风险偏好的银行在高利率下利润受损，而其他银行则受益。
AI.research_question: 利率变化对银行利润各组成部分的影响如何因银行特征和宏观审慎政策环境而异？
AI.motivation: 理解利率政策变化对银行盈利能力的影响机制，特别是考虑不同银行特征和宏观审慎政策环境的调节作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行利润分解理论（贷款损失准备金、净息差、非利息收入）、利率传导机制理论、宏观审慎政策有效性理论、银行异质性理论
AI.method: 实证分析方法，使用银行层面数据，考察利率变化对银行利润各组成部分的影响，并分析银行特征和宏观审慎政策的调节效应
AI.findings: 1. 高利率导致提供浮动利率贷款的银行增加贷款损失准备金；2. 严格的宏观审慎借款人措施能减弱高利率对贷款损失准备金的影响；3. 严格的宏观审慎政策降低失业率对贷款损失准备金的影响；4. 银行存在显著异质性：强风险偏好银行在高利率下利润受损，其他银行受益

AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行制定利率政策提供微观基础；2. 为监管机构设计宏观审慎政策提供实证依据；3. 帮助银行管理者理解自身业务模式对利率变化的敏感性

title: Fiscal Rules, Robust Correction Mechanisms, and Sovereign Spreads

detail.title: Fiscal Rules, Robust Correction Mechanisms, and Sovereign Spreads

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Both policy advice and economic theory advocate for fiscal rules with a clear anchor that reflects fiscal risk and a robust correction mechanism that implements a more ambitious fiscal consolidation when fiscal risk is higher. However, among more than 120 countries with fiscal rules, only six are identified as implementing such robust correction mechanisms: Armenia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Poland, and Slovakia. Using synthetic control methods and dynamic panel regressions, this paper finds that the introduction of fiscal rules with robust correction mechanisms has been particularly effective in these countries, triggering a persistent median spread reduction of about 25 percent, or 75 basis points, over one year.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，具有稳健修正机制的财政规则在少数国家（亚美尼亚、哥斯达黎加、塞浦路斯、捷克共和国、波兰和斯洛伐克）中特别有效，能带来约25%的利差持续降低。
AI.research_question: 具有稳健修正机制的财政规则是否有效降低财政风险？
AI.motivation: 虽然政策建议和经济理论都支持建立具有明确锚点和稳健修正机制的财政规则，但在120多个实施财政规则的国家中，只有6个国家真正实施了这种机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政规则理论，强调明确锚点反映财政风险和稳健修正机制的重要性。
AI.method: 使用合成控制方法和动态面板回归分析。
AI.findings: 引入具有稳健修正机制的财政规则在这些国家特别有效，导致中位利差持续降低约25%（75个基点），持续一年。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了具有稳健修正机制的财政规则理论的有效性，为财政规则设计提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实施稳健财政规则的实际效果证据，有助于改善财政风险管理。

title: Trust and Safety: An Approach to Countering Gender-based Violence
affiliations: and National Network to End Domestic Violence

detail.title: Trust and Safety: An Approach to Countering Gender-based Violence
detail.abstract: Gender-based violence (GBV) is a driver of the misuse of technologies-including harmful content and stalking-that spills over from the internet to products in the home, workplace, and on the streets. GBV encompasses a wide range of harms, targets, and threat models-all of which impact trust and safety work. This chapter outlines the intersections of GBV and trust and safety work at points of intervention ranging from responding to harmful actions to promoting Safety by Design. We also address the challenges trust and safety professionals face when doing this work: impacts to wellbeing; limited resources to respond to survivors; working with partners in civil society and beyond; and navigating perceived tensions between free speech and creating welcoming, safe communities.
