title: Using Generative AI to Mitigate Cognitive Biases in Strategic Roadmapping Workshops

detail.title: Using Generative AI to Mitigate Cognitive Biases in Strategic Roadmapping Workshops
detail.abstract: Cognitive biases in humans are primarily involuntary phenomena that require active mitigation in innovation processes, including strategic roadmapping. Cambridge's strategic roadmapping process (S-Plan) includes features to mitigate cognitive biases of workshop participants, but these analogue techniques are imperfect. The aim of this article is to demonstrate how generative artificial intelligence (GAI) can be used to further mitigate cognitive biases in S-Plan workshops. A key analogue technique to mitigate cognitive biases is to involve a diverse group of participants in the S-Plan workshop. The approach mitigates cognitive biases through cognitive diversity. This paper establishes that GAI, used within an abductive reasoning process, can further increase cognitive diversity. During the early ideation phases of the S-Plan process, GAI is employed to generate insights and a short list of strategic initiative hypotheses to be reviewed, discarded, revised and/or combined by workshop participants with their own ideas for future testing. This working paper is a key first step to demonstrate GAI can collaborate with humans within an innovative abductive reasoning process to assist with strategy design, strategic roadmapping, and other design thinking processes.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如何利用生成式人工智能（GAI）在剑桥战略路线图流程（S-Plan）中进一步减轻认知偏见，通过增加认知多样性来改进战略设计过程。

AI.method: 在S-Plan流程的早期构思阶段使用GAI生成见解和战略倡议假设列表，供工作坊参与者审查、修改和整合
AI.findings: GAI通过溯因推理过程能够进一步增加认知多样性，从而更有效地减轻认知偏见
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了GAI可以与人类在创新性溯因推理过程中协作，为战略设计和设计思维过程提供理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为战略路线图工作坊提供了使用GAI减轻认知偏见的具体方法，改进了战略设计流程

title: Towards a Restorative Approach to Legal Ethics and Professional Responsibility
affiliations: University of Windsor Faculty of Law

detail.title: Towards a Restorative Approach to Legal Ethics and Professional Responsibility
detail.abstract: This article explores the relationship between legal ethics and restorative justice. It is commonly observed that there exists a "decline" in professionalism among Canadian lawyers today. One of the persistent concerns is that legal ethics rules and the "standard conception" of professional role morality that underpins them, the neutral partisan, fail to strike the correct balance between client interests and the public interest. Building on this idea, this article argues that the legal profession should be reoriented around restorative justice as the moral foundation of a more progressive approach to legal ethics and professional responsibility. It translates concepts from restorative justice into ethical terms, grounding ideas about interdependence, community involvement, and public accountability into a list of restorative principles that can be readily applied by lawyers, firms, and other kinds of law practices. The article concludes by recommending a series of lawyering practices and professional regulatory measures that are consistent with taking a restorative principles-based approach. Ultimately, the article shows that restorative justice offers more than an alternative path for lawyers in criminal law settings. It constitutes a distinct set of obligations that, once implemented as legal ethics, has the potential to raise the moral consciousness of lawyers, facilitate collaboration within communities and across systems, and redefine the role of lawyers in the administration of justice, transforming conditions of law and society in a more equitable direction.

title: Medical AI, Civil Recourse Theory, and No-Fault Compensation

detail.title: Medical AI, Civil Recourse Theory, and No-Fault Compensation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence is increasingly integrated into clinical medicine, especially in radiology where it promises more accurate diagnoses and streamlined workflows. However, the integration of AI into healthcare systems raises complex questions about legal liability when AI-assisted decisions result in patient injury. Who should be liable? Legal scholars have proposed a range of tort reforms to address liability concerns, including various forms of strict enterprise liability to hold supply-chain actors liable. These proposals often view tort law as a regulatory tool to deter unwanted conduct and to compensate injured victims. But they also stretch tort principles beyond their doctrinal bounds.

This Article draws on civil recourse theory to contend that modern tort theories proposing tort reform do not serve the purpose of tort law. The purpose of tort law is to empower only injured victims of legally recognized wrongs to hold the tortfeasors accountable. Tort law is about wrongs and redress. Tort liability does not simply arise from harm but from a breach of a relational legal directive owed by the wrongdoer to the victim. This legal directive includes a duty on the wrongdoer not to violate the correlated right of the victim. If a patient cannot show that a physician, or any other “responsible” actor or entity, breached their duty, then no tort has been committed, regardless of the injury. Accordingly, the patient has no claim in torts for compensation. Calls for strict enterprise liability and tort reform fail to remain faithful to the foundational principles of tort law.

While it seems harsh to hold that the patient has no cause of action for her injury, this Article proposes a more pragmatic solution that dispenses with theory to offer victims a straightforward path to compensation: a no-fault compensation program for medical AI injuries modeled after the successful National Vaccine Injury Compensation Program. This approach ensures that patients harmed by medical AI systems receive compensation without having to overcome the evidentiary hurdles of the tort system. By shifting attention away from individual liability and toward no-fault compensation, this Article agrees with legal scholars, medical practitioners, and researchers that the benefits of medical AI are significant. However, actors involved in the development, production, deployment, and use of AI systems should not be deterred by liability concerns or economic disincentives. At the same time, this Article seeks to defend traditional tort law and its conceptual foundations.

AI.tldr: 本文基于民事追索理论，认为现代侵权法改革提案违背了侵权法的根本目的，并提出建立无过错补偿计划来解决医疗AI伤害赔偿问题。

detail.abstract: Transformative potential of the knowledge economy of the XXI century, establishment of networked society, emergency digitization due to the pandemic and wartime measures have imposed elaborate interdisciplinary and interoperable demands on the marketability of Liberal Arts skills and competences, upon entering the workforce. This study examines the gap between transdisciplinary future skіlls hіghlіghted іn the World Economіc Forum's (WEF) "Future of Jobs" reports and those sought by learners іn Coursera's Global Skіlls іndex. The emphasis lies on the role of Core skills combined with the Inner Development Goals (IDGs) framework in bridging these gaps. The proposed strategy roadmap links IDGs with the demands for future skills and Humanity-focused Higher Education (HiEd), besides, it provides actionable recommendations for HiEd staff, business schools and policymakers. By combining Inner Development with Leadership Skills and Digital Skills Programs in HiEd we may have a hope to stimulate employability for the AI age both for individuals' inner growth and collaboration/co-creation skills in teams and larger communities in a turbulent job market of 2025-2050. The study results disclose the comprehensive review of dynamics of the digital skills development and application to construe interdisciplinary, AI-interoperable competencies of students and educators in Europe through the span of educational activities in the time-frame of the pandemic emergency digitization measures of 2020-2021 and wartime emergency digitization measures of 2022-2024 in Ukraine (including AI-enhanced communication as a staple of transdisciplinary education as of 2023). The paper introduces a model of AI-interoperable digital skills for education and professional application in different social spheres. The survey analysis is used to evaluate the dimensions of interdisciplinarity, informed by the interoperability of soft skills, professional communication skills, and digital skills across contrasting frameworks of e-competence, Inner Development Goals, professional digital communication, and professional training.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Volta Foundation | BATTERY TALENT CENSUS REPORT | September 2025

detail.abstract: The battery industry has become foundational to the global energy transition and a linchpin of U.S. industrial competitiveness. The lithium-ion battery chain is positioned for extraordinary growth, potentially reaching a value of more than $400 billion by 2030 1. Beyond electric mobility and grid storage, new frontiers, ranging from electric aviation to AI data centers and defense, further amplify the strategic importance of batteries in the coming decades. Realizing the growth potential of the battery industry, however, requires addressing a fundamental constraint: talent shortages. The battery industry's rate of expansion is directly limited by workforce availability. Until now, conversations about battery talent gaps have been dominated by anecdotes and fragmented surveys. The Battery Talent Census, based on responses from over 1,000 industry professionals, provides the most comprehensive, data-driven snapshot of skilled knowledge workers powering the battery sector to date. This report presents the full results of the Census, covering everything from demographic insights on today's battery professionals to the skills and roles most in demand, evolving compensation and retention dynamics, and how students view their future career pathways. Recognizing that different audiences will prioritize different insights, we distill our key findings and recommendations into four stakeholder groups: educational institutions and content creators; students and job seekers; battery company leaders and recruiters; and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 电池行业面临严重人才短缺问题，这限制了行业增长潜力。电池人才普查基于1000多名行业专业人士的反馈，提供了最全面的数据驱动分析，涵盖人口统计、技能需求、薪酬动态和职业发展路径。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人才管理和行业发展理论，分析人才短缺对产业扩张的制约机制。
AI.method: 基于电池人才普查，收集了1000多名行业专业人士的反馈数据，进行全面的定量分析。
AI.findings: 提供了电池行业人才状况的全面数据驱动分析，包括人口统计特征、技能需求、薪酬动态、保留机制和学生职业发展路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了电池行业人才状况的实证数据，填补了此前主要依赖传闻和零散调查的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为四类利益相关者提供具体建议：教育机构和内容创作者、学生和求职者、电池公司领导和招聘人员、政策制定者，帮助解决人才短缺问题。

detail.title: Taming Spatial Imbalances in Freight Networks: Time-Based Mechanisms
detail.abstract: Digital freight brokerages connect shippers and carriers through online platforms, but inefficiencies arise due to empty backhaul miles when return shipments are unavailable. These inefficiencies persist due to drivers' preference for cyclic routes that start and end at the same location, yet drivers often face difficulty securing return loads, potentially reducing their long-term participation on the platform. To address this, we propose time-based mechanisms in which the platform assigns cyclic routes to drivers, who are compensated based on their on-duty time. Drivers endogenously decide whether to participate in the mechanism, and those who do not participate can try to directly provide service in the marketplace. We first characterize the driver equilibrium for the latter group of drivers through a convex program formulation of a generalized population potential game and show its existence and essential uniqueness. The platform's design problem is then formulated as choosing a mechanism that maximizes its profits in the induced driver equilibrium. We formulate this problem as a bilevel optimization problem, which is large-scale and non-convex. To address this difficulty, we propose a first-order method that leverages a reformulation of the equilibrium characterization as a regularized optimization problem. Using this framework, we conduct numerical studies based on U.S. freight data to assess the impact of time-based mechanisms on spatial supply-demand imbalances, platform profit, and driver surplus.

keywords: hedging JEL Classification: E58 -Central Banks and Their Policies

detail.abstract: In Liberia, the exchange rate is more than just an economic statistic; it profoundly shapes daily life. Fluctuations in the rate directly impact the cost of food, fuel, school fees, and other essentials. The Central Bank of Liberia (CBL) intervenes to stabilize the market, but its tools are limited in a highly dollarized economy where the U.S. dollar dominates transactions alongside the Liberian dollar. This paper proposes the introduction of foreign exchange (FX) options as a practical measure to manage volatility. The CBL would serve as the sole issuer, offering small, standardized over-the-counter (OTC) contracts tied to real trade. A tightly controlled pilot would minimize risk while delivering immediate benefits: giving businesses a straightforward way to hedge against currency swings while easing pressure on the Central Bank's reserves. The aim is not to add complexity but to provide a disciplined first step toward a broader framework for price stability, monetary management, and investment planning. By starting small, building trust, and expanding gradually, Liberia can adapt tested practices from other countries to lay the groundwork for a more resilient financial system.

detail.abstract: In this paper, we study the long-run effects of emigration on economic development. We consider the case of historical mass migration from Italy between 1880 and 1920, when more than 10 million people left the country. We exploit variation in access to information about opportunities abroad to derive an instrument for outmigration at the municipality level. We find that areas with higher historical emigration are poorer, less educated, and less densely populated at the turn of the 21st century. These effects emerged early and persisted, as emigration led to sustained depopulation that, combined with declining fertility and lower human capital investment, constrained the structural transformation from agriculture to manufacturing and services.

title: Measuring by Executive Order

detail.title: Measuring by Executive Order

detail.abstract:
Sound economic policymaking depends on trustworthy data. While theories, authority, and influence all play a role in shaping decisions, it is data that provides the essential foundation for understanding reality and building consensus. Accurate, timely, and credible statistics allow policymakers, businesses, and households to make informed choices. When trust in those statistics is undermined, the entire policy-making process suffers. This is particularly concerning in the United States, where millions of individuals and organizations rely on the work of federal statistical agencies to guide decisions with profound economic and social consequences.

Yet today the integrity of US economic data faces mounting pressures.Political interference, declining survey response rates, shrinking budgets, and growing mistrust in institutions all threaten the reliability of the numbers on which so much depends. While US agencies remain global leaders—closely followed and admired by their counterparts abroad—the risk is that credibility once lost may take decades to rebuild, as illustrated by experiences in countries such as Argentina. The stakes are high: without reliable statistics, policymakers may misjudge the economy’s health, investors may lose confidence, and the public may disengage from official measures altogether.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国经济数据完整性面临的威胁，包括政治干预、调查回应率下降、预算缩减和机构信任度降低等问题，强调了可靠统计数据对经济政策制定的重要性。

AI.motivation: 可靠的经济数据是有效政策制定的基础，但美国经济数据的完整性正面临多重压力，这可能对经济决策产生严重后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政策制定理论、数据可信度理论和机构信任理论，强调数据在政策制定中的核心作用。
AI.method: 理论分析和案例研究，通过比较美国与其他国家（如阿根廷）的经验来论证观点。
AI.findings: 政治干预、调查回应率下降、预算缩减和机构信任度降低正在威胁美国经济数据的可靠性，这可能误导政策制定、削弱投资者信心并导致公众对官方数据的疏离。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对数据可信度在政策制定中作用的理解，提出了数据完整性威胁的多维度分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、统计机构和公众提供了关于保护数据完整性的重要警示，强调了维护统计机构独立性和资源充足性的必要性。

detail.abstract: This study investigated the relationship between effective classroom management and students’ academic performance in biology in senior secondary schools in Anambra West Local Government Education Authority (LGEA) of Anambra State, Nigeria, with a view to knowing the management strategies teachers predominantly use in the classroom as well as teachers’ abilities towards managing it effectively. The study adopted a descriptive correlational design, and 100 students were drawn across five schools in the LGEA. The sample was drawn through stratified random sampling. A structured questionnaire was the instrument for data collection, and its validity as well as reliability were established using Cronbach's alpha coefficient, and the index was 0.84. Mean and standard deviation were used in answering the research questions, while Pearson product-moment correlation analysis was used in testing the hypotheses. The result indicated a positive and weak relationship between the independent and dependent variables.

detail.abstract: We introduce a USD Anchored Hybrid Barter (UAHB) system for physical goods. Goods are exchanged directly, and any imbalance in valuations is bridged by bounded cash side payments. Anchoring valuations in USD relaxes the double coincidence of wants while preserving barter as the primary mode of exchange. We show that UAHB weakly dominates pure barter in welfare terms and strictly improves efficiency when transfer frictions are small. The framework connects to the assignment game with transferable utility but introduces capped transfers so that the platform keeps a barter first identity. We outline testable implications for local exchange platforms and circular economy policy.

detail.abstract: This article provides a comprehensive integrated literature review and bibliometric analysis of academic research on Initial Coin Offerings (ICOs), spanning over a decade of scholarly output. Addressing a significant gap in existing literature, it systematically synthesizes the thematic evolution, key contributors, and intellectual architecture of the ICO domain. The review identifies five recurrent determinants of ICO success: high-quality whitepapers, transparent open-source activity, independent project ratings, multidisciplinary founding teams, and sustained community engagement, each influencing pre-ICO, launch, and post-ICO stages. It further examines prevalent forms of ICO fraud, including exit scams and "network scams," and assesses the efficacy of machine learning-based detection models while highlighting limitations posed by heterogeneous regulatory environments. Analysis of post-ICO performance reveals that strong internal governance, founder commitment, rapid exchange listings, and institutional investor participation are crucial for sustainability, noting a "sustainability paradox" where ESG-oriented ventures often underperform financially. The bibliometric analysis delineates a multidisciplinary field anchored by finance-law and computer science, with emerging streams in AI-enabled risk analytics, ESG tokenomics, and entrepreneurial finance. Leading authors such as Fisch, Momtaz, Adhami, Giudici, and Vismara are identified as central nodes of knowledge diffusion. This study offers a foundational understanding of ICO research, addressing its complexities, identifying persistent challenges, and proposing avenues for future investigation, particularly concerning real-time bibliometric monitoring, integrated on-chain and off-chain data analytics, comparative regulatory impact studies, and enhanced fraud mitigation strategies.

keywords: prediction of red blood cell products

detail.abstract: Background and Objectives: Red blood cells are often overprepared for surgery, leading to waste and increased costs, despite the need for cross-matching tests. This study aimed to develop a model for predicting the number of red blood cell units required during cardiovascular surgery using patient characteristics.Materials and Methods: This retrospective study included patients who underwent cardiovascular surgery at our hospital from April 2022 to October 2022. Multiple regression analysis was performed using preoperative patient attributes and blood data, with red blood cell units used during surgery as the objective variable. Models were developed using patient demographics and blood data, with additional models incorporating specific surgical procedures to assess predictive accuracy.Results: Model 1 included age, sex, weight, hematocrit, prothrombin time-international normalized ratio, serum creatinine, volume of preoperatively donated diluted autologous blood, and history of cardiovascular surgery. Model 2 included the same variables as Model 1, plus aortic aneurysm resection as a surgical procedure. The predictive equations of the study showed superior accuracy for both Model 1 and Model 2 compared to the conventional red blood cell units requested by physicians or those predicted using the surgical blood order equation based on correlation coefficients. Model 2 outperformed both Model 1 and conventional methods in predictive utility.Conclusion: This study developed a clinically useful formula for predicting the number of red blood cell units required during surgery based on preoperative patient-specific data, without restricting the analysis to specific procedures. This formula may improve blood product inventory management and reduce medical costs.

detail.title: Impact Flow Theory: A Dynamic Framework for Integrated Organizational Execution and Growth
detail.abstract: This paper presents the Impact Flow Theory (IFT) as a dynamic and integrative framework designed to enhance sustainable growth in volatile industries such as food service. Rooted in the interaction of information, resource, and motivation flows, IFT provides a comprehensive structure for aligning strategic goals with executional capacity. Drawing from agile strategy, performance monitoring, and both Western management theory and Eastern philosophical traditions, IFT enables organizations to respond to complexity with speed, clarity, and consistency. The framework is composed of five core pillars-Goal Cascading, Resource Optimization, Agile Strategy, Performance Monitoring, and Impact Measurement-all unified by the concept of interdependent flows. This paper elaborates on IFT's theoretical underpinnings, structural components, and practical applications within fast-paced, customer-facing environments.

AI.tldr: Impact Flow Theory (IFT) is a dynamic framework that integrates information, resource, and motivation flows to enhance sustainable growth in volatile industries like food service, enabling organizations to respond to complexity with speed and clarity.
AI.research_question: How can organizations in volatile industries like food service achieve sustainable growth through a dynamic framework that integrates information, resource, and motivation flows?
AI.motivation: The need for a comprehensive framework that aligns strategic goals with executional capacity in fast-paced, customer-facing environments where traditional approaches may be insufficient.
AI.theoretical_framework: Impact Flow Theory (IFT) - integrates agile strategy, performance monitoring, Western management theory, and Eastern philosophical traditions through the interaction of information, resource, and motivation flows.
AI.method: Theoretical framework development and conceptual analysis of IFT's structural components and practical applications.
AI.findings: IFT provides a comprehensive structure with five core pillars (Goal Cascading, Resource Optimization, Agile Strategy, Performance Monitoring, Impact Measurement) unified by interdependent flows concept.
AI.theory_contributions: Develops a novel integrative framework that bridges Western management theory with Eastern philosophical traditions, introducing the concept of interdependent flows as a unifying principle.
AI.practical_contributions: Enables organizations to respond to complexity with speed, clarity, and consistency in volatile industries, providing actionable guidance for sustainable growth in fast-paced environments.

affiliations: University of Regensburg - Center of Finance and University of Maine

detail.title: The Enterprise Multiple Investment Strategy: International Evidence

keywords: Enterprise Multiple Fama French factors book-to-market

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, volume 50, issue 4, 2015[10.1017/S002210901500023X]

detail.abstract: The enterprise multiple (EM) predicts the cross-section of international returns. The return predictability of EM is similarly pronounced in developed and emerging markets, and likewise strong among small and large firms. An international portfolio of low-EM firms outperforms a portfolio of high-EM firms by about 1% per month. The EM value premium is individually significant for the majority of countries, remains largely unexplained by existing asset pricing models, is robust after controlling for comovement with the respective U.S. premium, and is highly persistent for up to 5 years after portfolio formation, making it a promising strategy for investors.

AI.tldr: 企业倍数（EM）能够预测国际股票收益率的横截面差异。低EM企业的投资组合每月比高EM企业投资组合表现高出约1%，这一价值溢价在多数国家显著存在，且现有资产定价模型无法完全解释。
AI.research_question: 企业倍数（EM）能否预测国际股票市场的横截面收益率？
AI.motivation: 探索企业倍数在国际股票市场中的预测能力，为投资者提供有效的投资策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业倍数的价值投资理论，横截面收益率预测理论。
AI.method: 国际股票市场数据分析，构建低EM和高EM投资组合进行对比，控制其他因素进行回归分析。
AI.findings: EM对国际股票收益率的预测能力在发达市场和新兴市场同样显著，低EM投资组合每月超额收益约1%，该溢价在多数国家显著且持续5年。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实企业倍数在国际范围内的预测能力，扩展了价值投资理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际投资者提供基于企业倍数的有效投资策略，该策略具有长期持续性。

title: Breaking Down the U.S. Employment Multiplier Using Micro-Level Data
affiliations: University of California, San Diego, University of California, San Diego (UCSD), Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

detail.title: Breaking Down the U.S. Employment Multiplier Using Micro-Level Data
detail.abstract: Using newly matched U.S. defense contract and restricted administrative employment data, we show that the employment effects of defense procurement are costly, concentrated, and slow to diffuse. Employment gains are initially driven by large existing contractors and come at a high cost of approximately $290,000 per job-year. While employment in non-contracting firms is crowded out on impact, positive spillovers emerge gradually and account for half of regional employment gains by the third year after a spending shock, suggesting delayed but persistent medium-term gains across industries. Within contractors, only 15% of job creation occurs at recipient establishments, highlighting the role of supply chain linkages.

AI.tldr: 美国国防采购的就业效应成本高昂、集中且扩散缓慢。就业增长主要由大型现有承包商驱动，每创造一个人年就业的成本约为29万美元。虽然非承包企业的就业在初期被挤出，但正向外溢效应逐渐显现，在支出冲击后第三年占区域就业增长的一半。在承包商内部，只有15%的就业创造发生在接收合同的机构，凸显了供应链联系的作用。
AI.research_question: 国防采购对就业的影响如何？其成本、分布和扩散模式是怎样的？
AI.motivation: 理解国防支出对就业的实际影响，包括其成本效益、空间分布和时间动态，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区域经济学和劳动力市场理论，探讨政府支出对就业的乘数效应、挤出效应和供应链联系。
AI.method: 使用新匹配的美国国防合同数据和受限的行政就业数据，采用实证分析方法。
AI.findings: 1) 就业效应成本高昂（29万美元/人年）；2) 效应集中且扩散缓慢；3) 初期就业增长由大型承包商驱动；4) 非承包企业就业在初期被挤出；5) 正向外溢效应在第三年占区域就业增长一半；6) 只有15%的就业创造发生在合同接收机构。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了国防采购就业效应的复杂动态，挑战了传统乘数效应的简单假设，强调了供应链联系和时空扩散的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国防支出政策提供成本效益分析，帮助政策制定者更准确地评估国防采购对就业的实际影响和资源配置效率。

title: Economic impacts of population ageing in Latin America and the Caribbean Challenges and opportunities

detail.title: Economic impacts of population ageing in Latin America and the Caribbean Challenges and opportunities
detail.abstract: This document analyses the economic implications of rapid population ageing in Latin America and the Caribbean, highlighting both the challenges it poses for economic growth, the labour market, and the sustainability of social policies, as well as the opportunities it presents to boost various economic sectors in the region.

AI.tldr: 分析拉丁美洲和加勒比地区快速人口老龄化的经济影响，包括对经济增长、劳动力市场和社会政策可持续性的挑战，以及为区域经济部门带来的机遇。
AI.research_question: 拉丁美洲和加勒比地区快速人口老龄化对经济有何影响？
AI.motivation: 该地区正经历快速人口老龄化，需要了解其对经济各方面的潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口经济学、劳动力市场理论、社会保障理论
AI.method: 文献分析、数据分析和案例研究
AI.findings: 人口老龄化带来经济增长放缓、劳动力市场压力和社会保障可持续性挑战，同时也为某些经济部门创造发展机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对发展中国家人口老龄化经济影响的理解，丰富人口经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供应对人口老龄化挑战和把握相关机遇的建议，促进区域经济可持续发展。

title: Does the Term Structure of Interest Rates of German Government Securities Permit Arbitrage Opportunities?
affiliations: University of Maine

detail.title: Does the Term Structure of Interest Rates of German Government Securities Permit Arbitrage Opportunities?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Betriebswirtschaftliche Forschung und Praxis (BFuP), Volume 67, Issue 5 (2015), 554-561

detail.abstract:
This paper empirically analyzes a seminal finding set forth by Hering (1999) showing that strengthening the concept of strong absence of arbitrage is necessary to prevent arbitrage opportunities. Investigating a sample of 42 years (September 1972 to October 2014) reveals whether such a situation can exist for the term structure of interest rates of highly liquid German Government securities. This paper establishes that situations like these can occur frequently since the outbreak of the Eurozone crisis (more
than 70 % since 2011).

AI.tldr: 本文实证检验了Hering(1999)关于强化无套利概念必要性的理论，发现在欧元区危机爆发后，德国政府债券收益率曲线频繁出现套利机会（2011年后超过70%的时间）。
AI.research_question: 在高度流动的德国政府证券的利率期限结构中，是否存在违反强无套利条件的情况？
AI.motivation: 验证Hering(1999)的理论发现，即需要强化无套利概念来防止套利机会，并检验这一理论在现实市场中的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Hering(1999)的强无套利理论框架，探讨利率期限结构中的套利机会存在条件。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用1972年9月至2014年10月共42年的德国政府证券数据。
AI.findings: 欧元区危机爆发后，德国政府债券收益率曲线频繁出现违反强无套利条件的情况，2011年后超过70%的时间存在套利机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了Hering(1999)关于需要强化无套利概念的理论预测，为利率期限结构理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了欧元区危机后德国债券市场的套利机会特征，为市场参与者和监管机构提供了重要参考。

title: Green and Socially Responsible Investing in International Markets
affiliations: University of Regensburg, University of Maine and University of Regensburg - Center of Finance

detail.title: Green and Socially Responsible Investing in International Markets
detail.abstract: From an international perspective, we find strong evidence that green investments are significantly different from SRI investments in terms of financial performance and underlying firm characteristics. Green equities outperformed SRI equities between 2003 and 2007, whereas they underperformed between 2008 and 2012 with absolute multi-factor alphas of more than 1 percent per month in both directions. Green portfolios primarily contain stocks of low quality with weak business models that are highly capital-intensive but unprofitable, whereas SRI portfolios are predominantly characterized by stocks with well-conceived and profitable business models. We find that green investments can be considered as a sector bet on the renewable energy industry, shaped by massive governmental subsidies during the mid-2000s.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现绿色投资与SRI投资在财务表现和公司特征上存在显著差异。绿色股票在2003-2007年表现优于SRI股票，但在2008-2012年表现较差，多因子alpha绝对值均超过每月1%。绿色投资组合主要包含商业模式薄弱、资本密集但盈利能力差的公司，而SRI投资组合则主要是商业模式良好且盈利的公司。
AI.research_question: 绿色投资与SRI投资在财务表现和公司特征方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 从国际视角探讨绿色投资与SRI投资之间的差异，理解这两种可持续投资策略的本质区别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续投资理论、投资组合理论、多因子资产定价模型
AI.method: 实证分析，使用多因子模型评估投资组合表现，分析公司特征差异
AI.findings: 绿色投资在2003-2007年表现优于SRI投资，但在2008-2012年表现较差；绿色投资组合主要包含商业模式薄弱、资本密集但盈利能力差的公司，而SRI投资组合主要是商业模式良好且盈利的公司；绿色投资可被视为对可再生能源行业的行业押注。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了绿色投资与SRI投资在理论和实践上的本质区别，为可持续投资理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者区分绿色投资和SRI投资提供了重要参考，揭示了绿色投资的风险特征和周期性表现。

title: Navigating Environmental Regulations through M&As
affiliations: Beijing Technology and Business University, , Durham University Business School, Finance and Economics and Beijing Institute of Technology

detail.title: Navigating Environmental Regulations through M&As
detail.abstract: Our study examines how environmental regulations influence corporate acquisition strategies. Exploiting China’s Emissions Trading Scheme (ETS) as a quasi-natural experiment, we find that firms located in ETS-regulated regions are significantly more likely to acquire targets in non-ETS regions. This pattern is particularly pronounced among pollution-intensive industries, non-state-owned enterprises, and firms with weaker ESG performance or lower media attention. Further analysis reveals that these acquirers often divest assets in ETS regions while acquiring same-industry targets in non-ETS areas, effectively relocating production capacity to less regulated locations. Although such transactions generate higher short-term market reactions, they are followed by significant declines in the acquirers’ R&D investment and green innovation output. Overall, our findings suggest that firms strategically employ M&As to circumvent stringent environmental regulations, highlighting the need for coordinated policy frameworks to prevent regulatory arbitrage and mitigate carbon leakage.

AI.tldr: 研究发现企业利用并购规避环境监管，中国ETS政策下受监管地区企业更倾向于收购非监管地区目标，通过产能转移规避严格环境规制，虽然短期市场反应积极但长期抑制研发投入和绿色创新。
AI.research_question: 环境规制如何影响企业并购策略？
AI.motivation: 探讨企业如何应对环境规制，特别是通过并购进行监管套利的行为模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管套利理论、企业战略响应理论、环境规制经济学
AI.method: 利用中国碳排放交易体系(ETS)作为准自然实验，采用双重差分方法分析企业并购行为。
AI.findings: ETS监管地区企业更可能收购非监管地区目标，尤其在污染密集型行业、非国企、ESG表现差或媒体关注度低的企业中更明显；这些企业通过出售监管地区资产、收购同行业非监管地区目标来转移产能；短期市场反应积极但长期抑制研发和绿色创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业通过并购规避环境规制的战略行为机制，丰富了监管套利理论在环境政策领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供协调政策框架的必要性，防止监管套利和碳泄漏，促进环境规制的有效实施。

title: They Do Take It to Heart: The Impact of Data Breaches on the Employee-Organization Relationship
affiliations: University of Macau, University of Colorado Denver, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, University of Delaware - Alfred Lerner College of Business and Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: They Do Take It to Heart: The Impact of Data Breaches on the Employee-Organization Relationship
detail.abstract: In today's digital environment, data breaches are not only operational disruptions but also psychological shocks that reverberate within organizations. Prior research has emphasized managerial responses and market repercussions, yet we know little about how breaches reshape the employee-organization (E-O) relationship-the attitudes and bonds that link employees to their firms. Drawing on P-E fit theory, we theorize a breach-induced misfit phenomenon in which data breaches degrade the E-O relationship by diminishing employees' perceived fit in three core domains: work-life balance, corporate culture, and leadership. Using a rigorous design that combines propensity score matching and difference-indifferences , we find supportive evidence that data breaches erode the E-O relationship, as reflected in post-breach declines in employees' satisfaction with their firms-both overall and across each theorized domain. Moreover, the adverse effects are amplified when breaches clash with employees' core values or are especially severe. However, they are mitigated in firms with stronger recovery-supportive information systems capabilities. Finally, in an exploratory analysis, we delve deeper into the emotional nature of the breach-induced misfit, finding that such a sense of misfit stems primarily from the erosion of previously positive perceptions rather than a deepening of preexisting discontent. Together, the study shifts the breach impact conversation inward-beyond market-and management-focused lenses to the firm's internal relational fabric-demonstrating how cybersecurity failures degrade the E-O relationship.

AI.tldr: 数据泄露会通过破坏员工与组织在三个核心领域的匹配度来削弱员工-组织关系，这种负面影响在泄露事件与员工核心价值观冲突或特别严重时更为明显，但在具备更强恢复支持信息系统能力的企业中会得到缓解。
AI.research_question: 数据泄露如何重塑员工-组织关系？
AI.motivation: 现有研究强调管理响应和市场影响，但对数据泄露如何影响员工-组织关系知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 个人-环境匹配理论，提出泄露引发的匹配失调现象。
AI.method: 结合倾向得分匹配和双重差分法的严谨设计。
AI.findings: 数据泄露侵蚀员工-组织关系，表现为员工对公司满意度的下降；负面影响在泄露与核心价值观冲突或严重时加剧，但在具备强恢复支持信息系统能力的企业中缓解。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数据泄露影响的研究视角从市场和管理转向企业内部关系结构，展示网络安全失败如何削弱员工-组织关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了理解数据泄露对内部关系影响的框架，并指出加强恢复支持信息系统能力的重要性。

title: When Extinction Hits the Headlines: Biodiversity Risk-Sentiment, Stock Prices, and the Role of Accounting Conservatism
affiliations: Bocconi University, University of Padua - Department of Economics and Management and Catholic University of the Sacred Heart of Milan

detail.title: When Extinction Hits the Headlines: Biodiversity Risk-Sentiment, Stock Prices, and the Role of Accounting Conservatism
detail.abstract: This paper examines how biodiversity risk sentiment, proxied by biodiversity-related media coverage, affects stock returns and whether accounting conservatism in financial reports mitigates this effect. Analyzing U.S.-listed firms from 2010 to 2023 with a novel media-based biodiversity news index, we find that greater media attention to biodiversity is associated with significantly lower stock returns. However, firms that apply more conservative accounting experience attenuated negative reactions, consistent with conservatism’s role in reducing investor uncertainty and acting as a proxy for prudence and credible disclosure. Our findings contribute to research on ESG risk pricing and sustainability disclosure research, suggesting that conservative reporting functions as a managerial tool to improve firms’ resilience to biodiversity-related shocks and strengthen credibility in increasingly sustainability-conscious financial markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现媒体对生物多样性的关注度增加会显著降低股票回报，但采用更保守会计处理的企业能够减轻这种负面影响。会计稳健性通过减少投资者不确定性和作为审慎披露的代理机制，提高了企业对生物多样性相关冲击的韧性。
AI.research_question: 生物多样性风险情绪如何影响股票回报？会计稳健性是否能缓解这种影响？
AI.motivation: 随着可持续发展意识在金融市场中的增强，了解企业如何应对生物多样性相关风险变得日益重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ESG风险定价理论和可持续发展披露研究，探讨会计稳健性在降低投资者不确定性中的作用。
AI.method: 使用基于媒体的生物多样性新闻指数，分析2010-2023年美国上市公司的数据。
AI.findings: 媒体对生物多样性的关注度增加与显著较低的股票回报相关；采用更保守会计处理的企业负面反应较弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了ESG风险定价理论，揭示了会计稳健性作为管理工具在可持续发展背景下的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了通过保守会计报告增强对生物多样性冲击韧性的实践指导，有助于在可持续发展意识增强的市场中建立可信度。

title: An Empirical Study of “Schedule A” Litigation
affiliations: Chicago-Kent College of Law - Illinois Institute of Technology and Yeshiva University - Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law

detail.title: An Empirical Study of “Schedule A” Litigation
detail.abstract:
This Article offers a comprehensive empirical account of Schedule A intellectual property litigation and its consequences for remedies, due process, and forum choice. Using an original dataset of thousands of cases spanning trademarks, copyrights, and patents, we evaluate asset restraints such as ex parte TROs, the prevalence of default judgments, pendency and its implications, case geography, and repeat-player dynamics to report novel findings as well as update early accounts of the Schedule A phenomenon. First, Schedule A is a cross-regime enforcement technology with trademark actions comprising the large majority of filings. Suits that sound in copyright are frequent as well, while suits asserting patents—predominantly design patents—form the smallest but, in some ways, most salient share. Second, against a background of largely uncontested cases, extraordinary remedies issue with a regularity that is markedly higher than in comparable non-Schedule A IP cases and is potentially concerning. Third, the track is fast and standardized: pendency in Schedule A cases has shortened and converged over time, reflecting a routinized, template-driven process as compared to non-Schedule A IP cases. Fourth, the practice is highly concentrated: the Northern District of Illinois alone accounts for the majority of Schedule A cases to date—recently, the overwhelming majority. Meanwhile, a small minority of judicial districts are responsible for nearly all new filings, raising troubling questions about forum shopping that are familiar to scholars of IP litigation. Fifth, a small cadre of plaintiff-side repeat players has dominated filings and outcomes. Recent judicial pushback, especially in Chicago, signals growing skepticism toward sealed schedules, generic pleadings, and presumed asset dissipation. Together, these features risk remedial overreach, asymmetric bargaining leverage against foreign micro sellers, and the emergence of a bifurcated IP system—one that is sealed, default-driven, and forum-captive; the other, adversarial and nationally more uniform. The continued expansion of Schedule A litigation as a high-speed, low-information alternative to ordinary IP adjudication invites frank debate about calibrated reforms.

This article is forthcoming May 2026 in the Chicago-Kent Law Review's "Unsealing Schedule A" symposium, studentorgs.kentlaw.iit.edu/cklawreview/live-symposia/unsealing-schedule-a/.

AI.tldr: 本文对Schedule A知识产权诉讼进行了全面实证分析，发现这是一种跨领域执法技术，主要涉及商标案件，具有高度集中化、快速标准化、救济措施过度等特点，可能导致双轨制IP系统。

title: Fewer and better children, a happier life? Urban-rural disparities in the effects of fertility policy on elderly welfare in China
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - China Center for Human Capital and Labor Market Research and Central University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Fewer and better children, a happier life? Urban-rural disparities in the effects of fertility policy on elderly welfare in China
detail.abstract: This study documents the urban-rural disparities in the impact of the "Later, Longer, Fewer" (LLF) campaign, a fertility policy in the 1970s, on the welfare of the elderly exposed. Exploring the variation in policy exposure at the provincial and birth-cohort levels, we find that the LLF policy has a positive effect on urban elderly welfare, in terms of life satisfaction; whereas, it decreases the rural elderly welfare, in terms of mental and physical health. Furthermore, we find that the LLF policy resulted in significant quantity-quality tradeoff, which is stronger for urban elderly than their rural counterparts. The welfare gains for urban elderly can be attributed to the better child quality, while the welfare losses for rural elderly arise from the decrease in child quantity. Lastly, mechanism analysis demonstrates that intergenerational support serves as a critical pathway influencing elderly welfare outcomes. Our results highlight the interrelationship among fertility, elderly support, and urban-rural inequality.

title: Systematic Signed Jump Variation and Chinese Stock Return Predictability
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, and Hunan University

detail.title: Systematic Signed Jump Variation and Chinese Stock Return Predictability
detail.abstract: Using 5-minute intraday data for a large cross section of individual stocks, we construct a relative signed jump (RSJ) variation measure and decompose it into systematic (RSJS) and idiosyncratic (RSJI) components. We find that while aggregate RSJ predicts market returns with positive coefficients, the predictive power is primarily driven by the systematic component (RSJS). This result is robust both in-sample and out-of-sample after controlling for economic, realized, and liquidity variables, and it is economically meaningful in asset allocation. The positive predictability of RSJS reflects investors’ underreaction to good news and overreaction to bad news, mainly linked to cash-flow news. Furthermore, RSJS positively predicts cross-sectional stock returns, especially for firms that are difficult to value and costly to arbitrage.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了相对符号跳跃(RSJ)指标，并将其分解为系统性(RSJS)和异质性(RSJI)成分。研究发现系统性成分RSJS能够正向预测市场收益和横截面股票收益，这种预测能力主要源于投资者对好消息反应不足和对坏消息反应过度。

1. 系统性RSJS成分正向预测市场收益
2. 预测能力在样本内和样本外均稳健
3. 预测能力具有经济意义

title: Banks, Bucketing and VRDOs: A Detailed Analysis

detail.title: Banks, Bucketing and VRDOs: A Detailed Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable

detail.abstract: This article examines the consequences of deliberate or collusive misconduct by remarketing agents, banks, or rate-setting intermediaries on super-integrated derivative contracts tied to tax-exempt bonds. Specifically, it analyzes how manipulations in remarketing "bucketing" or rate determination could impair the integrity of arbitrage yield calculations, sever super-integration of hedges, interfere with arbitrage rebate compliance, and expose issuers, counterparties, and agents to claims of material misstatement, reissuance risk, or tax enforcement. The analysis demonstrates that while super-integration offers significant tax planning advantages, its efficacy depends critically on faithful yield mechanics and transparent rate-setting processes. The article argues for heightened scrutiny, documentation, and remedial protocols in compliance with Treasury Regulation § 1.1001-6 safe harbors, § 1.148, and principles of market transparency, while recognizing that comprehensive resolution may require unprecedented Federal Reserve intervention to address the structural crisis created by systematic bucketing practices operating outside disclosed bond document parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了在免税债券相关的超级集成衍生品合约中，承销商、银行或利率设定中介的蓄意或串通不当行为的影响。研究发现操纵再营销"分桶"或利率确定会损害套利收益率计算的完整性，破坏对冲的超级集成，干扰套利回扣合规，并导致重大虚假陈述、重新发行风险或税务执法索赔。文章主张加强审查、记录和补救协议，并可能需要美联储干预来解决系统性分桶实践造成的结构性危机。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于美国财政部法规§1.1001-6安全港条款、§1.148以及市场透明度原则的理论框架，分析超级集成衍生品合约的合规要求。

AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对超级集成衍生品合约风险机制的理解，提出了在复杂金融产品中维护合规性和透明度的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发行人、交易对手和中介机构提供了加强审查、记录和补救协议的具体建议，并指出可能需要美联储干预来解决系统性风险。

title: Breaking the Boundaries of Emotional Experience: Acknowledging Trauma with the Student Experiences Research Group (SERG)Using Cultural-Historical Activity Theory
affiliations: City University of New York

detail.title: Breaking the Boundaries of Emotional Experience: Acknowledging Trauma with the Student Experiences Research Group (SERG)Using Cultural-Historical Activity Theory
detail.abstract: Cultural-historical activity theory (CHAT) framed an understanding of trauma as it emerged from activities with the Student Experiences Research Group (SERG): a research group that engages community college students in research. The literature on trauma has boomed in recent years, but CHAT has rarely focused on it. Based on Vygotsky’s assertion that emotions are the beginning of higher psychological functioning, blocking emotional expression is theorized to create additional obstacles for development. Focusing on a single SERG meeting in which traumas were acknowledged, the stories students shared revealed the CHAT nature of adversity and suggested the need for new ways of acknowledging trauma in college. That conversation and subsequent activity signaled a desire and anxiety about breaking academic taboos, a need to normalize emotional expression within college, and the utility of acknowledging adversity. The difficulties students experience have been a routine part of college discussions, and the author’s experiences of how trauma is commodified are part of creating a CHAT response to student trauma. A trauma-informed pedagogy—informed by CHAT—can normalize trauma and help students develop from previously overwhelming emotional experiences to using those emotions as resources.

title: Sustainability of Agri-Business Supply Chain in India with Special Reference to Jharkhand : A Critical Literature Review
affiliations: , Birla Institute of Technology (BIT), Mesra - Department of Management and Birla Institute of Technology (BIT), Mesra - Department of Management

detail.title: Sustainability of Agri-Business Supply Chain in India with Special Reference to Jharkhand : A Critical Literature Review
detail.abstract: Purpose: The study explores the existing state of Indian agri-business supply chain and specifically of the state of Jharkhand through an extensive literature review. Methodology/Approach: The methodology used here is a systematic literature review on the area of agri-business supply chain. 268 papers selected for review from various databases like Science Direct, Emerald, Wiley, Taylor and Francis etc. These papers were published between 2014-2024, and early 2025. VOSviewer software used for Bibliometric analysis. Findings: Analysis shows that the overall status of research on the agri-business supply chain in the Indian context is in a nascent stage and very little paper available for Jharkhand. Issues found are the poor infrastructure, rural road connectivity, low market information to farmers, a high number of intermediaries, and poor coordination among supply chain partners. Research Implication: This study reviews literature from 2014 to February 2025 on agribusiness supply chains, using bibliometric analysis to identify key research trends. Findings highlight growing interest in applying Industry 4.0 technologies-Blockchain, IoT, and AIto enhance performance and sustainability. Managerial Implication : The study shows that adopting technologies like Blockchain, AI, and IoT can improve agribusiness supply chain efficiency and product quality. However, challenges such as storage, transport, rural infrastructure, farmer awareness, and market access require strong government support and policies to enhance overall system performance. Originality/Value: India invests heavily in agriculture, and Jharkhand has strong growth potential. Yet, limited research on supply chains hinders sustainability. This study adds to agribusiness literature with a focus on Jharkhand.

title: The Agreement that Brought the Nation to Completion and Extinction: Macedonian Political Parties and the Framing of the Prespa Agreement

detail.title: The Agreement that Brought the Nation to Completion and Extinction: Macedonian Political Parties and the Framing of the Prespa Agreement
detail.abstract: The 2018 Prespa Agreement has intensified the conflicting discourses about Macedonian identity politics, and the Macedonian state and its political future. The two largest Macedonian parties, the incumbent Social Democrats and the oppositional VMRO-DPMNE, have produced divergent narratives about the Agreement and its implications for the nation, and its identity and future. The Social Democrats have framed the Agreement positively by presenting it as a completion of Macedonian statehood and a protector of national identity, highlighting its benefits, especially the better future as an EU member. VMRO-DPMNE on the other hand, has negatively presented the Agreement as a political act that puts an end to Macedonian state sovereignty making the Macedonian national identity extinct. It is within this context of these conflicting interpretations that this chapter seeks to discuss the arguments and the discursive strategies that structure the positive/negative presentations of the Agreement.

title: Outpatient Spatial Layout and Wayfinding Efficiency: Quantitative Assessment and Design Implications for Healthcare Operations
affiliations: Zhejiang University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Zhejiang University

detail.title: Outpatient Spatial Layout and Wayfinding Efficiency: Quantitative Assessment and Design Implications for Healthcare Operations
detail.abstract: Large multifunctional hospitals create complex outpatient environments that reduce spatial legibility, slow patient flow, and compromise efficiency. This study examines how spatial configuration shapes wayfinding efficiency (WE) and presents the Spatial Layout Assessment for Wayfinding Efficiency (SLAWE), a quantitative framework integrating space syntax indicators with patient characteristics. Analyses in three tertiary hospitals in four outpatient zones combine space syntax simulations with an experiment (50 participants; 600 observations). WE was operationalized using two behavior metrics: Hesitation Time Density (decision latency) and Hesitation Count (decision frequency). Geometrically regular layouts were associated with lower hesitation time, whereas visually complex or weakly differentiated environments showed higher hesitation frequency. Age and education moderated these relations: older adults hesitated longer, while higher educational attainment predicted more efficient wayfinding. SLAWE links spatial configuration to measurable performance and provides a transferable decision-support tool to diagnose layout inefficiencies, prioritize retrofits, and inform legible, inclusive, and operationally efficient outpatient design.

title: Presidents and Vaccines: Head of State Inoculation as a Tool for Vaccine Promotion
affiliations: University of Antwerp - Institute of Development Policy and Management, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Antwerp - Institute of Development Policy and Management and University of Antwerp - Institute of Development Policy and Management

detail.title: Presidents and Vaccines: Head of State Inoculation as a Tool for Vaccine Promotion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The studies involving humans were approved by the University of Antwerp Ethical Advice Committee (file SHW_19_03).
declarations.funderStatement: The author(s) declare that financial support was received for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article. This research was funded by the Research Foundation Flanders (scholarships 12W8320N and 11L9623N) and the University of Antwerp’s Research Fund (DOCPRO – BOF scholarship FFB190256).

detail.abstract: Introduction: Vaccine hesitancy, an important threat to global health, has increased since the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic. The public vaccination of high-profile figures, such as heads of state, has been touted as a potential tool for increasing vaccine acceptance among the general population. However, systematic information on such role modelling is lacking and existing studies focus on a small number of high-income countries. We take advantage of the COVID-19 pandemic to fill this gap. Methods: Through a systematic search of internet sources, we first document that most global leaders supported the vaccination campaign and actively communicated their vaccination status to the public. We then turn to a case study to provide experimental evidence on vaccine role modelling for a country in Africa-the region that is most lagging behind in achieving universal immunization coverage. We rely on a randomized survey experiment with 600 citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo and take advantage of the fact that the Congolese President publicly received a COVID-19 vaccine during the survey period. Results and discussion: Our findings demonstrate that the impact of political leader's role modelling is moderated by trust and depends on media outreach and access. When trust in leaders is lacking, or news on their actions is inaccessible, alternative ambassadors and effective communication methods become crucial in motivating and informing the public. This may be especially relevant in fragile states and remote regions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了政治领袖作为疫苗榜样对公众接种意愿的影响，发现在信任度低或媒体覆盖不足的情况下，领袖示范效果有限，需要替代性大使和有效沟通策略。
AI.research_question: 政治领袖作为疫苗榜样是否能有效提高公众的疫苗接种意愿？这种影响如何受到信任和媒体覆盖的调节？
AI.motivation: 疫苗犹豫是全球健康的重要威胁，COVID-19大流行期间尤为严重。虽然高知名度人物的公开接种被视为提高疫苗接受度的潜在工具，但缺乏系统性研究，特别是对低收入国家的研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 角色模范理论、信任理论、媒体传播理论
AI.method: 采用系统性的互联网来源搜索和随机调查实验，以刚果民主共和国600名公民为样本，利用总统公开接种疫苗的时机进行研究。
AI.findings: 政治领袖的榜样作用受到信任和媒体覆盖的调节。当缺乏对领袖的信任或媒体报道不足时，领袖示范效果有限，需要替代性大使和有效沟通方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了角色模范理论在公共卫生领域的应用，强调了信任和媒体覆盖在榜样效应中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为脆弱国家和偏远地区的疫苗推广提供了实践指导，强调需要多元化的沟通策略和替代性大使来弥补领袖示范的局限性。

title: A State-Dependent Riccati Equation Index Policy for Dynamic Production Sequencing in Compounding Pharmacies
affiliations: IE Business School, Indiana University - Kelley School of Business and Indiana University - Kelley School of Business

detail.title: A State-Dependent Riccati Equation Index Policy for Dynamic Production Sequencing in Compounding Pharmacies

declarations.funderStatement: This project has received funding from the EU’s Horizon 2023 research and innovation program under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie European Postdoctoral Fellowship Grant agreement No 101150714.

detail.abstract: When patients require personalized medications or medications that are otherwise unavailable, e.g., due to patients' allergies or drug shortages, retail pharmacies must rely on compounding pharmacies that produce medications to order. Inspired by discussions with the management team of a compounding pharmacy, this project aims to improve timely access to compounded medications through the development of a dynamic production control algorithm designed to minimize the time between the prescription request and when the medication is ready. We propose and evaluate a novel and theory-driven implementable heuristic policy based on a fluid model of production dynamics paired with a State-Dependent Riccati Equation controller, lightly modified for use as a value function approximation technique that serves as the basis of a simple index policy. Numerical studies suggest that for large systems this heuristic is within 11% of a lower bound on waiting cost per unit time within a representative fluid setting demonstrating strong theoretical performance. Within a data-driven simulation with more than 1000 unique medications where arrival rates are dynamic and must be estimated, a hybrid policy combining an age-limit with the proposed heuristic can reduce the average cost of waiting time by 25% compared to the status-quo oldest request sequencing policy without increasing worst case delays. The proposed heuristic thus contributes a novel and easily implementable approach to production sequencing within compounding pharmacies and a generalizable approach to challenging multiproduct production management problems where optimal policies are intractable.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种动态生产控制算法，旨在减少复合药物从处方请求到准备就绪的时间。该算法基于流体生产动力学模型，结合状态依赖Riccati方程控制器，提出了一种易于实施的启发式策略。在数据驱动模拟中，该混合策略可将平均等待时间成本降低25%，且不增加最坏情况延迟。
AI.research_question: 如何通过动态生产控制算法改善复合药物的及时获取？
AI.motivation: 当患者需要个性化药物或因过敏或药物短缺而无法获得标准药物时，零售药店必须依赖按订单生产药物的复合药店。通过与复合药店管理团队的讨论，本项目旨在减少从处方请求到药物准备就绪的时间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于流体生产动力学模型，结合状态依赖Riccati方程控制器，将其轻微修改作为价值函数近似技术，作为简单索引策略的基础。
AI.method: 提出并评估了一种新颖的、理论驱动的可实施启发式策略，通过数值研究和数据驱动模拟进行验证。
AI.findings: 对于大型系统，该启发式策略在代表性流体设置中与等待成本下限的差距在11%以内。在包含1000多种独特药物的数据驱动模拟中，结合年龄限制的混合策略可将平均等待时间成本降低25%，且不增加最坏情况延迟。
AI.theory_contributions: 为复合药店的生产排序提供了一种新颖且易于实施的方法，并为具有挑战性的多产品生产管理问题提供了一种可推广的方法，其中最优策略难以处理。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一种可实际实施的动态生产控制算法，显著改善了复合药物的及时获取，为药店运营提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Competitive Analyses of Local Bakeries in Prishtina/ Republic of Kosovo
affiliations: University of Prishtina, AAB College - Faculty of Economics and

detail.title: Competitive Analyses of Local Bakeries in Prishtina/ Republic of Kosovo
detail.abstract: The main problem of today's companies is the division between marketing and sales as separate departments in company, or better saying, including the sales as division within the marketing department. Through this "regulation" of departments, enterprises will have more knowledge about market and competition and will be a step forward their competitors. The main purpose of this paper is to identify competitive analyses of local bakeries in the Capital City of Kosovo, Prishtina, and define how they act toward the competition and what strategies they use to compete in a very competitive business environment, pricing or quality based products offered to customers. While doing a research and analyzing competition and competitive strategies of bakeries, I found out that most of bakeries are based on achieving their competitive advantage in the market through lower prices than competitor and few of them based its strategy toward offering qualitative products and services to the customers and through it they have a better image and got customer loyalty. This situation is as a result of not having marketing department in any bakery or a person who is responsible for marketing. The only reason for not having established marketing was that these companies need more time to transition from sales to marketing activities. The data for research were collected through questionnaire in fifteen bakeries within the Prishtina city. Methods used for research have been descriptive, comparative, analysis, and synthesis. The research instrument was a questionnaire, the technique has been direct communication and research was conducted between months February and March 2012.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究科索沃首都普里什蒂纳当地面包店的竞争分析，发现大多数面包店通过低价策略获得竞争优势，少数通过优质产品和服务建立客户忠诚度。研究发现缺乏营销部门是导致这种状况的主要原因。
AI.research_question: 普里什蒂纳当地面包店如何应对竞争，以及他们使用什么策略在竞争激烈的商业环境中竞争？
AI.motivation: 当今公司的主要问题是营销和销售部门分离，将销售作为营销部门内的一个部门，企业将获得更多关于市场和竞争的知识，并在竞争中领先一步。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争分析理论、竞争优势理论、营销与销售整合理论
AI.method: 描述性、比较性、分析和综合研究方法，通过问卷调查收集数据，在2012年2月至3月期间对15家面包店进行直接沟通调查
AI.findings: 大多数面包店通过比竞争对手更低的价格获得竞争优势，少数面包店通过提供优质产品和服务建立更好的形象和客户忠诚度。缺乏营销部门是导致这种状况的主要原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 为小企业在竞争环境中的战略选择提供了实证证据，验证了营销部门在建立可持续竞争优势中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为当地面包店提供了从销售导向向营销导向转变的实践指导，强调了建立营销职能对于长期竞争优势的重要性

title: Managing Green Transition Through Promotion: Evidence from Kosovo Businesses
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics, AAB College - Faculty of Economics and AAB College - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Managing Green Transition Through Promotion: Evidence from Kosovo Businesses
detail.abstract: The green economy is redefining business operations in relation to sustainability and environmental challenges. The aim of this study is to examine the role of green transition promotion in the success of businesses, with close reference to sustainability challenges, support, and strategic priority. The study seeks to determine how various determinants affect the attitude of businesses towards the success of green transition promotion. A quantitative research approach was undertaken with the help of a survey questionnaire, which was administered to 397 companies. The data obtained were examined using statistical methods, such as correlation analysis, regression analysis, and ANOVA to identify significant relationships and ascertain factors that most impact companies' views about the success of the green transition. The findings reveal that the perceived importance of green transition for firms is the most potent predictor of the success of promotion activities. Further, firms that have actively engaged in green transition or have been assisted by institutions consider promotion to be less necessary. Barriers to promoting green transition also negatively affect the perceived impact of promotion. This research is restricted by the fact that it only addresses Kosovo businesses, which might not be illustrative of businesses from other parts of the world. In addition, the responses to the survey might be affected by self-reporting bias. Future studies could increase the sample size and geographical coverage and add qualitative approaches for more insightful results. The findings suggest that firms that prioritize the green transition need to focus on enabling sustainable behaviours as a core aspect of their strategy. Policymakers and organizations can render green transition efforts of firms more effective by offering more targeted support to firms, especially weaker ones. This study contributes to the literature by providing empirical results of companies' perceptions of the role of the promotion function in the green transition. It is useful in that it links promotion strategies to real-world issues facing companies, with conclusions that differ from previous studies that were predominantly focused on the technical or financial aspects of the green transition.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨绿色转型推广在企业成功中的作用，发现企业对绿色转型重要性的认知是推广活动成功的最强预测因素，而积极参与转型或获得机构支持的企业认为推广必要性较低，推广障碍对推广效果有负面影响。
AI.research_question: 各种决定因素如何影响企业对绿色转型推广成功的态度？
AI.motivation: 绿色经济正在重新定义企业在可持续性和环境挑战方面的运营方式，需要研究绿色转型推广在企业成功中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色经济、可持续发展、企业战略优先等理论框架。
AI.method: 定量研究方法，通过调查问卷对397家公司进行调查，使用相关分析、回归分析和方差分析等统计方法。
AI.findings: 企业对绿色转型重要性的认知是推广活动成功的最强预测因素；积极参与转型或获得机构支持的企业认为推广必要性较低；推广障碍对推广效果有负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了企业对绿色转型推广功能看法的实证结果，将推广策略与企业面临的实际问题联系起来，与以往主要关注绿色转型技术或财务方面的研究结论不同。
AI.practical_contributions: 优先考虑绿色转型的企业需要将可持续行为作为战略核心；政策制定者和组织可以通过提供更有针对性的支持来使企业的绿色转型努力更有效，特别是对较弱的企业。

title: Venture Capitalists vs. Deep-Pocketed Incumbents: Startup Financing Strategies in the Presence of Competitive Threats
affiliations: University of Sydney Business School, UNSW Australia Business School, School of Banking and Finance and UNSW Business School

detail.title: Venture Capitalists vs. Deep-Pocketed Incumbents: Startup Financing Strategies in the Presence of Competitive Threats

publicationDetails.detailsText: UNSW Business School Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: UNSW Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine how venture capitalists (VCs) adapt their financing strategies to support startups competing against deep-pocketed incumbents. Employing textual analysis to identify a startup's potential competitors, we show that when competitors are cash-rich, VCs deploy a financing strategy characterized by less conditionality, observed through larger, less frequent funding rounds, that are less contingent on short-term performance. This strategy requires VCs to rely more on continuous monitoring and liquidation protections and is restricted to larger funds with specialized experience. Our results suggest that, as incumbents have gained greater financial power, VCs serve as a counter-balancing force to sustain business dynamism.

AI.tldr: 风险投资机构在面对资金雄厚的竞争对手时，会采用条件更少的融资策略（更大规模、更少频次的融资轮次），这需要更强的持续监控和清算保护，且仅限于大型专业基金。

AI.practical_contributions: 为初创企业和风险投资机构在面对资金雄厚竞争对手时的融资策略提供实践指导，有助于维持市场竞争活力

title: Political question doctrine in Hungary and Europe. An overview

detail.title: Political question doctrine in Hungary and Europe. An overview

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the MTA János Bolyai Research Scholarship and the ÚNKP-22-5 New National Excellence Program of the Ministry for Culture and Innovation from the source of the National Research Development and Innovation Fund.

detail.abstract:
This paper is a brief summary of my habilitation lecture, which was held on 3 November 2022 at ELTE’s Faculty of Law. The title of lecture and the thesis was “Judicial review of governmental acts and the political question doctrine”. The thesis will be published in book form in 2024. At the end of this paper, I will briefly introduce my three-year long (2022–2025) research project funded by the MTA Bolyai Scholarship, which is a sequel to my habilitation research. 

The main question of my habilitation research is whether governmental actions can be subject to judicial review. Although holding the government to account is an important element of democracy, it is not obvious that every action of the executive branch can be reviewed by the judiciary. Government is a complex activity that has an essentially political nature but regulated by law. It involves setting strategic goals for a political community and monitoring their implementation, and ideological choices between alternatives that express values. As a result, governance largely means taking discretionary decisions with political content. That’s why governing politicians must be accountable to the people. On the other hand, implementing political decisions is not the government’s but the public administration’s task, which is, as a bureaucratic administrative apparatus, the “engine room” of the state.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨政府行为是否应受司法审查，分析政府行为的政治性质与司法审查的界限，并介绍了后续研究计划。
AI.research_question: 政府行为是否应受司法审查？
AI.motivation: 政府问责是民主的重要元素，但并非所有行政部门的行动都适合司法审查，因为政府活动具有本质上的政治性质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治问题理论、政府问责理论、行政与司法权力分立理论
AI.method: 理论分析和法律原则探讨
AI.findings: 政府行为具有政治性质，涉及战略目标设定和意识形态选择，因此司法审查应有限度；而公共行政作为国家执行机构则应受更严格的司法监督。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对政治问题理论的理解，明确政府行为与公共行政行为的区别，为司法审查界限提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法实践提供指导，帮助法院在审查政府行为时更好地平衡民主问责与权力分立原则。

title: Self-Regulatory Strategies and Extrinsic Motivation as Predictors of Effective Learning of Statistics Among Undergraduate Students
affiliations: and Federal College of Education Okene

detail.title: Self-Regulatory Strategies and Extrinsic Motivation as Predictors of Effective Learning of Statistics Among Undergraduate Students
detail.abstract: This study employs descriptive correlational design to determine whether self-regulatory strategies and extrinsic motivation can predict effective learning of statistics among undergraduate students. The study's population sample consists of the second year undergraduate students in five departments of FCE, Okene, Kogi State, Nigeria: an affiliate of University of Ibadan, offering Statistics in Education. Simple random sampling was used in selecting the sample size of 200 across the five departments.One research instrument consisted ofstudents' self-regulatory strategies (SSRS) and students' extrinsic motivation (SEM); and one constructed academic performance proforma were used for the 108 study. The reliability was obtained through crombach alpha coefficients of 0.85 and 0.78 respectively. Data collected was analyzed using regression analysis, pearsonproduct moment correlation and correlational matrix. The study's results show that self-regulatory strategies and extrinsic motivation have the ability to improve students' academic performance, and revealed more to academic performance of students taking statistics.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用描述性相关设计，探讨自我调节策略和外部动机是否能预测尼日利亚本科生的统计学学习效果。研究发现这两种因素都能显著提升学生的学业表现。
AI.research_question: 自我调节策略和外部动机是否能预测本科生统计学学习的有效性？
AI.motivation: 了解影响统计学学习的关键因素，为提升统计学教育质量提供依据

title: Moving for Good: Educational Gains from Leaving Violence Behind
affiliations: University of Tennessee, Knoxville - College of Business Administration - Department of Economics and University of Florida

detail.title: Moving for Good: Educational Gains from Leaving Violence Behind

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper estimates the effects of moving away from violent environments into safer areas on migrants' academic achievement in the context of the Mexican war on drugs. Using student location choices across space and over time, we recover individual-level migration paths for elementary school students across all municipalities in Mexico. We find that students who were induced to leave violent areas due to increased violence experience academic gains after relocating to safer areas.  Students who migrated from municipalities in the 90th percentile of the violence distribution to municipalities in the 10th percentile experienced improvements of 5.3 percent of a standard deviation in their test scores two years after they migrated. These results appear to be explained by increases in school attendance and improvements in the learning environment after they moved.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了墨西哥毒品战争背景下，从暴力环境迁移到安全地区对移民学生学业成绩的影响。研究发现，因暴力增加而离开危险地区的学生在搬迁到安全地区后学业成绩有所提升。
AI.research_question: 从暴力环境迁移到安全地区对移民学生的学业成绩有何影响？
AI.motivation: 在墨西哥毒品战争的背景下，理解暴力环境对学生教育成果的影响，以及迁移到安全地区是否能改善他们的学业表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境对教育成果影响的理论框架，特别是暴力环境对学生学习行为和学业表现的负面影响。
AI.method: 使用学生地理位置选择数据，追踪墨西哥所有城市中小学生的个体迁移路径，分析暴力水平与学业成绩的关系。
AI.findings: 从暴力分布90百分位的城市迁移到10百分位城市的学生，在迁移两年后测试成绩提高了5.3%的标准差。这种改善主要归因于出勤率提高和学习环境改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境暴力对教育成果影响的理论提供了实证支持，揭示了迁移到安全环境的教育收益。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策和移民政策提供了重要参考，表明改善暴力地区学生的安全环境可以显著提升其学业成就。

title: Refugee Exposure and Political Backlash: Poland during the Russia-Ukraine War
affiliations: University of Bath, University of Antwerp and Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, School of Business and Economics

detail.title: Refugee Exposure and Political Backlash: Poland during the Russia-Ukraine War

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of immigration on voting behaviour. Exploiting a unique natural experiment, we research parliamentary election results in Poland following the 2022 inflow of Ukrainian refugees. We exploit the variation in hosted refugees across Polish counties and utilise a shift-share instrument based on the past settlement of Ukrainian immigrants. We find increased support for far-right and right-wing (incumbent) political groups, at the expense of centre parties. There is important regional variation in this overall pattern. The more liberal areas in west Poland experienced political polarisation, with both far-right and left-wing parties gaining support. Furthermore, the rise in far-right support is particularly pronounced in rural counties, low wage counties, and those bordering Ukraine. The effects are driven by changing voter preferences, rather than election participation or natives internal mobility, and are not rooted in adverse economic effects. Our findings show that exposure to refugees, even those with a similar background and favourable profile, can still be associated with natives backlash.

AI.tldr: 本文利用波兰2022年乌克兰难民潮作为自然实验，研究发现难民流入导致对极右翼和右翼执政党的支持增加，而中间党派支持下降。效应在西部自由地区表现为政治极化，在乡村、低工资和边境县尤其明显，主要由选民偏好改变驱动。

detail.abstract:
In early 2024, the Savannah Bananas were more popular than ever. The team provided an innovative mix of baseball and entertainment—with everything from dancing base coaches to a batter on stilts—that sold out ballparks nationwide, captivated fans through social media, and disrupted an entire market. The organization's philosophy of “Fans first, entertain always” created an atmosphere that drew thousands of spectators to each game and millions online. The Bananas' 2024 home-game and touring schedule was completely sold out, and their leadership team, led by owner Jesse Cole, had to decide on a strategy for moving forward: one that could bring their modified version of baseball, called Banana Ball, to as many fans as possible while retaining the joy and fan focus at the heart of each Bananas game. Where should the Savannah Bananas go from here?At the University of Virginia Darden School of Business, this case is used in the second-year MBA “Venture Capital Leadership” course to discuss innovation and market disruption. It would also be suitable in courses covering marketing, strategy, and leadership.

title: Birkenstock: Pricing the 2023 Initial Public Offering
affiliations: University of Virginia - Darden School of Business and

detail.title: Birkenstock: Pricing the 2023 Initial Public Offering

publicationDetails.journalName: Darden Case Collection

detail.abstract:
This case examines the October 2023 initial public offering (IPO) of Birkenstock, the iconic German footwear maker. Students are invited to recommend the price at which Birkenstock should sell the shares offered in the IPO. Relevant considerations include the recent underperformance of a number of comparable IPOs and the influence of majority owner private equity firm L Catterton and luxury powerhouse LVMH. The case is designed to showcase corporate valuation using discounted cash flow (DCF) and peer-company market multiples for a company with high near-term growth and profitability. At the University of Virginia Darden School of Business, it is taught in the core finance curriculum.

Excerpt

Birkenstock: Pricing the 2023 Initial Public Offering

We see ourselves as the oldest start-up on earth.

—Oliver Reichert, CEO

In early October 2023, the executive team of Birkenstock Group (Birkenstock) faced a pivotal moment in the company's nearly 250-year history. The German footwear icon, renowned for its contoured cork-latex footbed and premium comfort sandals, was preparing for the initial public offering (IPO) of its equity. Oliver Reichert, CEO of Birkenstock, weighed the company's surging financial performance against the backdrop of a volatile global economy. The IPO's timing and pricing were critical as investors assessed whether Birkenstock could sustain its recent growth trajectory and justify its valuation.

The IPO aimed to offer to the public a 17% equity stake (32.3 million shares), for Birkenstock to be registered with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) as a foreign company, and for the shares to be listed for trading on the New York Stock Exchange. While the company boasted a strong brand heritage and robust financials—annual revenue growth had been 31% over the past two years—analysts and investors debated the underlying valuation of the company. Given recent dramatic price reversals following the IPOs of peer footwear companies Allbirds, Inc. (Allbirds) and Dr. Martens plc (Dr. Martens), some investors were wary. Reichert and his team sought to balance Birkenstock's tremendous potential with the market's appetite for risk as they considered how to price the shares.

title: Informality and Shock Propagation in an Open Economy
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Informality and Shock Propagation in an Open Economy

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The informal sector accounts for a large fraction of the economy and labor force in many emerging market and developing economies. This paper develops a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model of a small open economy with an informal sector. Nominal price and wage rigidities are present in the formal sector, while prices and wages are flexible in the informal sector. Production of traded goods rely more on formal inputs (which can be produced at home or imported) while non-traded goods rely more on informal inputs. We show that, despite its costs, the informal sector can provide a flexible margin of adjustment in labor and product markets which helps buffer the impact of domestic and external shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含非正规部门的小型开放经济体的动态随机一般均衡模型，发现尽管存在成本，但非正规部门可以通过提供劳动力和产品市场的灵活调整来缓冲国内外冲击的影响。
AI.research_question: 非正规部门如何影响小型开放经济体对国内外冲击的响应？
AI.motivation: 非正规部门在许多新兴市场和发展中经济体中占据重要地位，但现有研究对其在宏观经济波动中的作用关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态随机一般均衡模型，包含正规和非正规两个部门，正规部门存在名义价格和工资刚性，非正规部门价格和工资灵活。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟分析，构建小型开放经济体DSGE模型。
